After the resolution of the novel coronavirus, we hope that many people from both domestic and abroad will visit Aomori Prefecture again.

title: “まるで海外”な青森の絶景スポットを紹介！「ここも青森」CM
description: Aomori has scenic spots that evoke images of Hawaii, Cappadocia, and Northern Europe. Due to the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, it has been difficult to travel abroad, but please take a look at the spots in Aomori where you can enjoy a bit of an overseas atmosphere! Of course, there are also plenty of unique attractions that can only be found in Aomori.

title: 透明な海、左右からの波　～尻屋埼灯台～1
description: Aomori Blog

title: DELISH AOMORI「風間浦村のあんこうのベーコン巻き」
description: The recipe video 'Delish Aomori' delivered by all of Aomori is finally at its last episode, the 12th. The final ingredient is the anko from Kazamaura Village. Kazamaura Village is very close to the fishing grounds for anko, and exceptionally fresh anko is landed. When you think of anko, the first thing that comes to mind is probably anko nabe (stew). The recipe introduced this time is 'Bacon-Wrapped Anko', which can be enjoyed deliciously in a Western style. The combination of the mild anko flesh and the umami and saltiness of the bacon is exquisite. We will also deliver the lively atmosphere of the Kazamaura Anko Appreciation Festival, which is held once a year in Kazamaura Village.

title: DELISH AOMORI「ふかうら雪人参のポタージュ」
description: This is the 11th recipe video of 'DELISH AOMORI', delivered by all of Aomori. The ingredient this time is 'Fukaura Snow Carrot', cultivated in Fukaura Town. We have created a potage soup that deliciously captures the fruity sweetness that is unlike any other vegetable while enjoying the flavor of the carrot itself. Please give it a try.

title: DELISH AOMORI「津軽百年食堂　清おばあちゃん」
description: Kuroishi-shi no Konan Tetsudo Kuroishi Eki-mae ni mise o kakumeru 'Sugou Shokudo' wa Taisho jidai kara 4 dai ni watatte uketsugare, 'Tsugaru Hyakunen Shokudo' no 1 ten ni kazoeraremasu. Genzai no ten'nushi, Sugou Kiyo-san wa 87-sai to natta ima demo, chouri tantou to shite gen'eki de mise ni tachi tsuzukete iru obaachan desu. Mise to tomo ni hyakunen uketsugaru kawaranai aji to, dokoka natsukashisa o oboeru mise no fun'iki o tsutaeru, DELISH AOMORI ga otodoke suru Special Movie desu.

title: DELISH AOMORI「ミサオおばあちゃんの笹餅」
description: In Goshogawara City, Kanagi Town, 90-year-old energetic grandma Misao Kuwata continues to make the very popular sasa mochi. This is a special movie brought to you by DELISH AOMORI, where you can experience both the scene of making the sasa mochi that brings happiness to those who eat it and the warm personality of Misao.

title: DELISH AOMORI「美味しい土鍋ごはんの炊き方」
description: This is the 7th recipe video of 'DELISH AOMORI', delivered by all of Aomori. We cooked the special A rice, Seiten no Hekireki, harvested in Hirakawa City, in a donabe to make it fluffy, and served it with a famous accompaniment from Aomori, salted salmon roe! 'DELISH AOMORI' will be released on the all of Aomori Facebook page.

title: DELISH AOMORI「南部太ねぎのグラタンスープ」
description: This is the 5th installment of the recipe video 'DELISH AOMORI' delivered by Marugoto Aomori. The traditional vegetable 'Nambu Tai Negi' from the Nambu region of Aomori Prefecture is characterized by its astonishing thickness, melt-in-your-mouth texture, and sweetness. The gratin soup made with 'Nambu Tai Negi' is exquisite. 'DELISH AOMORI' is released regularly on the Marugoto Aomori Facebook page.

title: DELISH AOMORI「いたや毛豆のレアチーズムース」
description: The fourth installment of the recipe video 'DELISH AOMORI', delivered by Marugoto Aomori, has turned the sweet and rich characteristics of the fluffy edamame into a dessert. 'Itaya Edamame' is a local variety of edamame grown in Itayanagi Town, Aomori.

title: DELISH AOMORI「田舎館村のイチゴフィズ」
description: This is the second recipe video of 'DELISH AOMORI' brought to you by Marugoto Aomori. This time, we introduce a slightly stylish and sweet-sour 'Strawberry Fizz' made with strawberries from Inakadate Village.

title: 寒立馬の横断
description: On the way to Shiriya Cape Lighthouse, I encountered a temporary road closure.

title: 風間浦鮟鱇、めがった～（おいしかったー）
description: This is the second part of the 'Kazamaura Anko' edition of the 'Winter Aomori Trip' featuring writer Rei Ooka, Ura Kaze master, photographer Naoki Matsukuma, and travel writer Fumiko Yamauchi.

title: 下北の酒と風間浦鮟鱇、め～よ～（うまいよー）！
description: Writer Rei Ooka, sumo wrestler Ura Kaze, photographer Naoki Matsukuma, and travel writer Fumiko Yamauchi go on a 'Winter Aomori Trip' vol4. 'Kazamaura Anko' edition part 1.

title: イサバのカッチャ（魚市場のかあちゃん）
description: Since the post-war period, 'Isaba' has been rooted in the lives of people as the kitchen of Hachinohe. Isaba refers to the fish market. The Mutsu Minato Station morning market is bustling with many people every morning. Isaba's Katcha is a hard worker, starting her work in the dark. This text introduces the life of the seaside through Katcha, who has been shopping at the morning market since she was born.

title: べこもち
description: A traditional local sweet called 'Beko Mochi' that has been passed down in the Shimokita Peninsula of Aomori Prefecture. It used to be served during events such as festivals, but is now enjoyed daily. This work narrates the process of making Beko Mochi solely through visuals. Please take a look at the beautiful floral patterns that appear on the cut surface.

title: サナブリ
description: In the Tsugaru region of Aomori Prefecture, after the rice planting is completed, the villagers enter a farming break and hold a ritual called 'Sanaburi' as a prayer for a good harvest. The people of Ainan in Goshogawara City, Tsugaru region, talk about how this event has been a moment of relaxation for the community for a long time and how eagerly they have been looking forward to it. There is also a scene where they jump into the rice fields just after planting the seedlings.

title: ホワイトインパルス
description: Aomori Airport is one of the major heavy snowfall areas in Japan, with cumulative snowfall exceeding 10 meters in years with heavy snow. Among the airports with regular commercial flights, it is rare for an airport to have a cumulative snowfall exceeding 10 meters. Supporting this heavy snowfall at Aomori Airport is the Aomori Airport Snow Removal Group 'White Impulse', formed by a consortium of multiple companies.

title: はるえさん最高！ by浦風親方
description: This is the third volume of the 'Winter Aomori Trip' featuring writer Rei Ooka, Urakaze Oyakata, photographer Naoki Matsukuma, and travel writer Fumiko Yamauchi, focusing on 'Harue Shokudo' in Aomori City Furukawa Market.

title: 古川市場のっけ丼
description: Nokkedon is a bowl where you can buy a little bit of what is lined up at the Aomori Fish and Vegetable Center and eat it. You can buy your favorite ingredients in your preferred amounts, so it can be enjoyed alone, with friends, couples, or family.

title: ねぶたの家 ワ・ラッセ
description: Aomori City Cultural Tourism Exchange Facility 'Nebuta House Wa Rasse' introduces the history and charm of the Nebuta Festival, providing a dream space where you can fully experience everything about Nebuta.

title: はるえ食堂
description: A delicious grilled rice ball from Yokoyama Shoten (commonly known as 'Harue Shokudo') located in Furukawa Market, Aomori City.

description: The culture brought by the Omorogawa River blooms in 'Shinba', where a golden carpet spreads in the autumn in the village of 'Shikida'. This video is filled with the 'charm' of each area discovered by local residents through workshops conducted as part of the Akita City City Promotion Model Project.

title: さくら便り　千秋公園
description: A place of relaxation for the citizens of Akita City, Chushu Park. Every spring, about 700 cherry trees bloom beautifully. Enjoy the cherry blossoms that match perfectly in any part of the park.

title: 千秋公園「はちみつソフト」秋田美人が実食♪
description: Chishū Park, located just next to Akita Station, offers a chance to enjoy nature throughout the four seasons. It is also a popular tourist spot where you can meet Akita dogs and Akita maiko. A new specialty, 'Honey Soft,' has appeared in the park. Three Akita tourism ladies quickly tried it. Made with honey from Akita City, it has a refreshing taste that is not too sweet, and it is sure to be a hot topic this summer! Be sure to give it a try~♪

title: 平成最後の土崎港曳山まつり
description:
【Citizen Reporter Ando's Post】

July 20 and 21, the Tsuchizaki Port Hiyama Festival. During the climax of the returning hiyama, several town neighborhoods perform a 'hikimawashi' where they vigorously turn at intersections. The scene of the huge hiyama being turned by the hiko-tachi working together is nothing short of spectacular. It was an exciting two days at the end of the Heisei era!

Photographed by: Ando-san

title: 秋田犬ふれあい処 in千秋公園オープン！
description: A spot where you can interact with Akita dogs has opened in Chuo Park's Ninomaru!

title: 秋田竿燈まつり【KANTO】　ナレーション無し
description: Akita City's summer night sky is adorned with Kanto. The brilliance of the light rice ears and the skill of the Kanto handlers will surely overwhelm you with their beauty and power! Please come to the Akita Kanto Festival in August. (Produced by Akita City Tourism Promotion Division)

title: 千秋公園・秋田城跡歴史資料館・如斯亭
description: Nous vous présentons trois installations qui représentent l'histoire et la culture de la ville d'Akita ainsi que la beauté de la nature.

title: 雄物川花火大会
description: A dynamic fireworks display floating in the summer night sky of Akita City.

title: 大正寺おけさ
description: Taisho-ji Okesa is a valuable folk song culture that originated from the 'Hiyabushi' passed down in the Kyushu region and is said to have been propagated by the Kitamae ships.

title: 伝統の技　秋田の竿燈　　KANTO
description: This is an important intangible folk cultural asset of the country and is counted among the three major festivals of Tohoku. The Akita Kanto Festival is held every year from August 3rd to 6th on Kanto Street. Please come and see the wonderful skills of the performers who skillfully manipulate the Kanto and the fantastical scenery of golden ears of rice illuminating the night sky of Akita City.

title: ダリアと菊の魅力をお届け！
description:
The Akita Central Region Local Product Utilization Promotion Council (commonly known as the 'Farmers' Party Network') is collaborating with JA Akita Namahage and the cities of Akita, Oga, and Katagami to promote the utilization of local products and to enhance the agricultural, forestry, and fishery industries as well as the food-related industries in the three cities through various activities.

This PR video showcases the production sites of dahlias and chrysanthemums produced in the three cities, with the mayors of the three cities and the chairman of JA Akita Namahage personally promoting their charm to everyone!

description: The Omoriyama Zoo in Akita City, which opened on September 1, 1973, has celebrated its 50th anniversary. We have produced a commemorative video packed with 50 years of events supported by many people and animals, so please take a look!

title: Discover Ikeda#003 植木のまち・大阪府池田市で寄せ植え体験をしよう
description: The third installment of the Ikeda City tourism PR video features the comprehensive garden shop 'Yoshoen'! They sell a variety of plants and gardening supplies, mainly bonsai. You might feel that 'bonsai' is a bit intimidating, but everyone is friendly and will teach you kindly. Various bonsai experiences, including the potted planting experience that Tori is trying, are also available.

title: RAKUGO DE NAGOYA
description: これは、日本の伝統的なパフォーミングアート「落語」を通じて名古屋の観光を促進するビデオです。このビデオは、名古屋の街の素晴らしい映像を提供します - 「面白い街、訪れる価値のある街」。私たちと一緒に、祖父と孫の物語を通じて名古屋の街を探検しましょう！

title: RAKUGO DE NAGOYA

title: RAKUGO DE NAGOYA

title: RAKUGO DE NAGOYA

Come and Find, Your NAGOYA!」です。マニラ出身のテレビ愛知アナウンサー、オカダ・メグミ・マリーが、日本に住むフィリピン人のステファニーとアリサと共に名古屋の魅力を案内します。（「EEGANE！」は名古屋弁で「素晴らしい！」という意味です。）この動画は「名古屋の食」と「神社」の2パターンを制作しました。名古屋独特の食文化「モーニング」を味わったり、山田天満宮でお金を洗ったりすることができます。名古屋で良い運を見つけてください！体験をテーマに名古屋の魅力を伝える動画でした。ぜひご覧ください！

title: 名古屋神社めぐり旅
description: Did you know that Aichi Prefecture has the most shrines and temples in Japan? In this area with many shrines and temples, there are over 700 'shrines' located in Nagoya city. Shrines are closely related to the history of the land, and you can enjoy various stories. How about exploring the 'shrines' in the city of Nagoya, in addition to tourist attractions and facilities?

This year, the Seki City Lion Dance Preservation Society and the Mino Kabuki Preservation Society performed.

Lion Theater 'Koyasan'

[Summary] Shido Maru, longing to meet his father, Hoshiji (Karakaya Doshin), leaves his sick mother behind and walks alone to Koyasan. While walking on the mountain path, he encounters his father, Karakaya Doshin, and innocently asks, 'Where is Doshin now?' Doshin replies, 'Those who have just become monks are all called Doshin now,' and advises him to return. When Shido Maru tells him about his mother's illness, tears well up in Doshin's eyes. Seeing this, Shido Maru wonders if he might be his father, but Doshin says, 'Hoshiji Nyudo is currently on a pilgrimage across the country, and I do not know his whereabouts,' and urges him to hurry down the mountain to care for his mother.

Ginan Town Fire Brigade achieved 5th place among 20 fire brigades in the prefecture. This is the first award in small pump operations in 24 years!

The skills competition is held to improve the firefighting skills and morale of the fire brigade. The participating members underwent rigorous training for about four months for this competition, and even those who did not participate supported the competitors by training together.

description: A route starting and ending at the 'Cycling Terminal Rinrin'. The beautiful sunset over the East China Sea with the ria coastline, as well as the stunning views of Sakurajima and Kaimondake towering over Kinko Bay, are exceptional. This area is filled with attractions such as samurai residences, Satsuma ware kilns, shochu distilleries, and katsuobushi factories.

The landscape of rice fields supported by the abundant water of the Kirishima mountain range and tea fields producing famous tea stretches endlessly.

Experience a journey full of historical romance, including the cliffs of Koshikijima, which retain layers from 8,000 years ago, the town where Satsuma samurai lived, recognized as a Japanese heritage site - the samurai residence group 'Roku' - and the 'Sato Roku' and 'Teuchi Roku' components, as well as the 'Satsuma Domain British Student Memorial Museum' that contributed to Japan's modernization by learning from Satsuma students.

In the video, Junichi Miyashita, a sports caster from Kagoshima and Satsuma ambassador, enjoys the flavors of chicken sashimi and the sweetness of soy sauce in an infinite loop with shochu, showcasing the representative gourmet of Kagoshima and conveying the charm of Kagoshima's ingredients. description: Kagoshima Prefecture has 100 hot spring areas, ranking second in the nation with over 2,700 hot spring sources, and boasts more than 220 million liters of hot spring water flowing daily, making it one of Japan's premier hot spring kingdoms. In addition to the rare sand bath hot springs, there are many attractive hot springs throughout the prefecture, allowing visitors to enjoy various types of spring water. The video features Junichi Miyashita, a sports caster from Kagoshima and Satsuma ambassador, experiencing relaxation at the Kirishima hot spring area, conveying the charm of Kagoshima's hot springs. Let's take a break in Kagoshima's hot springs and rejuvenate both mind and body!

description: Higashishiuya Falls, selected as one of Japan's top 100 waterfalls, is referred to as 'Kyushu Kegon' due to its resemblance to Kegon Falls in Nikko. The sight of water cascading down the 85-meter cliff is breathtaking, and it is filled with negative ions. Additionally, it is a noble and beautiful waterfall, characterized by the clear stream flowing from the waterfall basin and the stunning beauty of the stream. The scenery is magnificent in both spring, when the fresh greenery shines in the clear water, and autumn, when the leaves change color.

title: 長洲神社葵祭り
description: Nagasu Aoi Festival is held every year from May 3rd to 5th at Kamo Shrine in the Nagasu area, celebrating the blessings of the mountains and the sea. During the festival, floats parade through the town of Nagasu to the sounds of drums and flutes. The origin of the festival dates back to the 11th year of the Horeki era (1761), when an epidemic occurred in the Buzen province, and floats were dedicated to appease it. At its peak, there were seven floats, but currently, two floats are pulled by the recently revived 'Onishi Float Group' and the 'Uemachi Float Group,' which has inherited traditions from the Edo period, wishing for good health and abundant harvests.

In the 6th year of Reiwa, the 38th Kentyusai will feature participants dressed in Nara period costumes as they walk from Shirahama Onsen town to Yama Shrine. title: けふの下呂温泉
description: February 25th (Saturday) was the launch of the 'Winter Gero Onsen Fireworks Story'.

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
February 4th (Saturday), the appearance of the 'Winter Constellation Fireworks'.

Although the cold was severe on that day, there was no rain or snow, making it a perfect day for fireworks. Fireworks inspired by stars were launched into the clear night sky. The beautiful fireworks captivated the customers, rivaling the stars themselves.

As the saying goes, 'three cold days and four warm days,' it seems that warmer days are gradually increasing.

We appreciate your continued support for Gero Onsen.

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: January 21st (Saturday) was the scene of the 'Winter Gero Onsen Fireworks Story'. The theme was 'Spring Come, Come - Cold Ending Fireworks', expressed with warm-colored fireworks to mark the end of the cold period. It was a very cold night, but many customers came to see the fireworks. Three weeks have passed since the New Year, and Gero Onsen is starting to get into full swing. We will do our best to provide everyone with an even more wonderful experience at Gero Onsen than last year. Fireworks will also be launched next weekend on January 28th (Saturday), so please come and see them. We appreciate your continued support for Gero Onsen.

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: The Gero Onsen has completely entered autumn, and if you want to enjoy the autumn leaves, 'Onsen-ji' is recommended. You can see the magnificent autumn leaves even during the day, but don't miss the autumn leaves light-up event from November 11 (Friday) to 20 (Sunday). From 16:30 to 21:00, the autumn leaves will be illuminated, and you can stroll through them. Admission is free, and you can enter and exit freely, making it perfect for a night walk while paying your respects. As the cold is getting stronger, don't forget to prepare warm clothing.

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
On May 21st (Saturday), the 'Gero Onsen Fireworks' themed 'Love Letter Fireworks' was held.

Although it was rainy on the day, it had completely lightened up by the start time, and the fireworks were successfully launched. As per the theme, the passionately launched fireworks drew cheers from the audience, and towards the end, a grand applause erupted. We hope to see even more guests next week.

Of course, don’t forget to enjoy the hot springs. Please enjoy the smooth skin from the alkaline water.

Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
On May 14th (Saturday), the 'Tenjo Mukyu, Evil Spirits Dispersal, Gero Onsen Fireworks' was held for the first time in a while.

Although a slightly chilly night breeze was blowing, many customers gathered to watch the fireworks. The dynamic 'Koinobori Fireworks' drew cheers, filling the night of Gero Onsen with vitality.

The weather has been unstable lately, but I hope we can enjoy the fireworks next week without being rained on.

Of course, don’t forget to enjoy the hot springs after watching the fireworks. Soaking in the foot bath at the 'Funsen Pond' in Shirakagi Green Park is also nice.

Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: On April 2nd (Saturday), the 'Gero Onsen Fireworks' themed 'New Life Support Fireworks' was held. The first fireworks of the new fiscal year captivated the guests beautifully. It seemed to be a support for the new life about to begin. The temperature has also become quite spring-like, and it may be time to say goodbye to heating soon. Even if we part ways with heating, we want to continue enjoying the hot springs throughout the seasons! Let's soak in the hot springs to adjust our health during this time of change in our lives! Thank you for your continued support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
Rare heavy snow in Gero Onsen, I headed to see the Gassho village dressed in snow.

The Gassho village, which I usually see, is a world of silver. It looks like a completely different place. I warmed my body in the hand bath and foot bath while walking on the snowy path.

The Gassho houses covered in snow have an excellent atmosphere, and I was able to enjoy it even more than usual. Of course, the slide couldn't be used, but while snow shoveling is tough, it’s fun to experience the Gassho village in this form once in a while.

On such snowy days, hot springs are the best! Let’s soak in the Gero Onsen and recharge for the new year!

Thank you for Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: On December 11th (Saturday), the 'Year-End Appreciation Fireworks' themed 'Tenjo Mukyu, Evil Disease Dispersal, Gero Onsen Fireworks Story' was held. Many customers came despite the cold, cheering at the fireworks that were launched. With only a little time left this year, we want to prepare for the end and for the coming year. The 'Fireworks Story' was held in the green park, where winter illuminations were also lit. In a romantic atmosphere, we could see customers there as well. As the cold increases these days, we find ourselves longing for hot springs even more! We appreciate your support for Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
On November 27th (Saturday), we had the 'Sweets Fireworks' event. Once again, many customers came to enjoy the pastel-colored fireworks themed around sweets, and there were cheers all around.

Watching the fireworks made me crave some sweets. Gero Onsen has a lot of sweets available, so please enjoy them.

Before we knew it, November is coming to an end, and December is just around the corner. The 'Tenjo Mukyu Akueki Taisan Gero Onsen Fireworks Story' is scheduled to be held until March, so we can still enjoy it for a while longer.

Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
Last week, I took photos of the autumn leaves around Iwaya Dam, Takako Pond Park, and Gyokuryuji Temple.

Under the clear skies, I was able to see the vibrant autumn leaves, but at the same time, the fallen leaves were becoming noticeable. It is said that the leaves fall rapidly as it gets colder, and with the recent drop in temperature, this year's autumn leaves may have already fallen.

Snow was visible on the peaks of the mountains seen from the hot spring town, as if announcing the transition from autumn to winter.

Now is the time to warm up your body in the hot springs and prepare!
Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: On November 20th (Saturday), the 'Tenjo Mukyu, Evil Spirits Dispersal, Gero Onsen Fireworks Story' was held with the theme of 'Labor Thanksgiving Fireworks'. This event was a prelude to Labor Thanksgiving Day on November 23rd (Tuesday), where we express gratitude for the labor and production that supports our lives (3 and 9), and magnificent fireworks were launched. It is said that this day originally stems from the celebration of Niiname-sai, which expresses gratitude for the bountiful harvest. There are various theories about how gratitude for the harvest transformed into gratitude for labor, but thinking about how we can enjoy fireworks like this makes me feel a deep appreciation for our ancestors. Now, to reward our labor, there’s nothing better than a hot spring! I hope we can enjoy the next fireworks while soaking in the hot springs! Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: From November 12 (Friday), the 'Onsenji Surrounding Light Up' has started at Onsenji Temple. You can enjoy the autumn leaves, which are at their best, even at night. The majestic scenery of the temple and the autumn leaves seems to calm the mind. Customers have come to take photos and stroll, and a quiet and peaceful time flows. Unfortunately, some of the regular events have been canceled due to COVID-19 prevention, but exhibitions such as '190-Year-Old Art Exhibition!!' and 'Living with Plant Dyeing Exhibition' are being held. Please come and see. After enjoying the autumn leaves light up, of course, let's soak in the hot springs! Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: This is the scene from the 'Tenjo Mukyu, Banish Evil Spirits, Gero Onsen Fireworks Story' held on November 6th (Saturday), inspired by the autumn leaves adorning the mountains of Hida. Despite the increasing cold, many customers were enjoying the fireworks with cheers. It is said that the origin of autumn leaves dates back to the Nara and Heian periods, and they continue to entertain many people even today. To warm up a body chilled by the night breeze, hot springs are perfect! By the way, it seems that starting with a half-body bath is more effective than immersing the whole body from the beginning. Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: I heard that the autumn leaves are at their best, so I headed to 'Gandate Park' in Hida-Kosaka. The 'Gandate' in the name refers to the cliffs made of lava, which are designated as a natural monument by the prefecture, and I was overwhelmed by their grandeur. The mountains are adorned with red and yellow autumn leaves, and I could enjoy the scenery while walking along the promenade. There is also a waterfall along the way, and seeing the sunlight streaming through the waterfall up close is incredibly powerful. I was able to enjoy forest bathing as well, fully savoring the autumn atmosphere. Since it is just the right time to see the leaves, if you want to enjoy the autumn foliage, please hurry. Please also take care of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
R3.10.28

I took photos of one of the autumn foliage spots in Gero Onsen, Gassho Village.

It seems that it was still a bit early for the peak foliage, as there weren't many trees with autumn colors. However, the colors of the trees that have already started to change were very beautiful. I can't wait to see the entire area in stunning autumn colors.

Gassho Village has a foot bath, so it seems nice to enjoy the hot springs amidst the autumn leaves. Of course, don't forget the other foot baths and hot springs located throughout Gero Onsen.

Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
Recently, I felt the coolness of autumn, but today, Gero Onsen feels like summer has returned with strong sunlight. I find myself wanting something cold.

I walked about 30 minutes from Jomon Park to the historical Mori Mihara Shidai. On the mountain path, the leaves are still green, and I can hear the voices of cicadas, reflecting the summer climate. The breathtaking view from Mihara Shidai of the town and mountains still looks like summer.

However, on the way to Mihara Shidai, I noticed chestnut husks falling, indicating that autumn is gradually approaching. I look forward to the season of autumn leaves.

After enjoying the stunning view, let’s indulge in the hot springs! Thank you for Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
I stepped into the Hida River at dusk.

Although the sunlight is strong, I realize that the heat of summer is not as intense, and autumn is approaching. The wind is also cool, and when I put my hand into the river's flow, I felt the coldness more than the refreshing coolness I had experienced before. The sunset reflected on the river surface looked somehow calm.

I would like to go and take pictures when the beautiful autumn leaves can be seen. I hope to introduce Gero Onsen in autumn as well.

Now, soaking in the hot springs while feeling the arrival of autumn is exceptional!

Anytime throughout the four seasons, the exquisite hot springs await! Please take care of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: Today, let's take a stroll around Gero Onsen in search of 'Nyarang Gourmet'!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
Gero Onsen is experiencing consecutive days of sunny weather. The sunlight and temperature feel like summer in full swing, and the cicadas are chirping energetically.

I visited the Gassho Village again and enjoyed 'Bankoan Mitsu' at Bankoan. It’s a unique anmitsu made with konnyaku and tomatoes, served with pickled plums and black syrup as a palate cleanser. You can enjoy it as is at first, and then try drizzling black syrup on it for a fun change in flavor. Combining red bean paste with konnyaku, cream with shiratama, and tomatoes with matcha ice cream is also an interesting experience.

After enjoying the anmitsu and exploring Gassho Village, please come to the hot springs! A refreshing sensation awaits that will blow away the summer heat!

There are plenty of hot springs that are perfect for any season! Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: Today, I went to Ujō Park, about a 10-minute walk from the hot spring town.

title: けふの下呂温泉

title: けふの下呂温泉
description: Seeking beautiful skin sweets, let’s head to 'Périgord Coffee Roastery'. I ordered 'Tochi Nut Crush Ice'. It comes with vanilla ice cream and French toast, accompanied by the Gero specialty 'Tochi Nut Senbei', which is rich in antioxidant properties. The elegant sweetness of the chilled vanilla ice cream, the gentle texture of the French toast, and the crunchiness of the 'Tochi Nut Senbei' blended together to create an exquisite dish that I finished in no time. The heat was blown away, and I felt refreshed both physically and mentally. The deliciousness made me want a second serving. Without forgetting the aftertaste, off to the hot springs! Further refreshment is to be expected! A town of hot springs and sweets that are gentle on the skin! Please take care of Gero Onsen!

description: Today is also hot in Gero Onsen.

title: けふの下呂温泉
description:
I went down to the Takehara River in the Ogawa area.

The green trees are vibrant, and the sound of the flowing water is pleasant to the ears.
The water is very clear, and when I put my hand in, it felt cool, providing a refreshing sensation in the hot sunlight.

This Takehara River merges with the Hida River, and thinking that it is part of that large flow makes me feel somewhat strange.

Now, during these hot days, let’s cool off with a hot spring!
Thank you for your support of Gero Onsen!

Chris Peppler, a TV and radio personality serving as a special ambassador for "The Castle Town Built by Akechi Mitsuhide, Fukuchiyama," stars in a promotional video for Fukuchiyama City, Kyoto Prefecture.

Chris Peppler, believed to be a descendant of Akechi Mitsuhide, was appointed as an ambassador at Fukuchiyama Castle in February 2019. In March, the PV "Chris Peppler Fukuchiyama Castle New Lord Inauguration Press Conference" was released, and this is a sequel to that.

In the previous video, I expressed my aspirations to "contribute to the further development of Fukuchiyama City" and was appointed as the lord, but in this video, I narrate about Fukuchiyama Castle as the lord. I am happy that Fukuchiyama is gaining momentum starting from the castle, and I hope that this video will further pique interest in Fukuchiyama Castle and Fukuchiyama so that this momentum will continue to grow next year.

This work is the 5th installment of the "Unknown Charm of Akechi Mitsuhide Project," which aims to spread the unknown charm of Akechi Mitsuhide, who built Fukuchiyama Castle, and its connection to Fukuchiyama City nationwide!

title: ５月の香美町
description: Today marks the end of May. Due to the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, many people were unable to visit Kamitown during the self-restraint period in May. Here, I would like to introduce a little bit of the scenery of Kamitown in May. Please enjoy the views from the Kamitown tourism poster shooting locations: 'Kasumi Coast', 'O-katsura of Wae', 'Uhe Mountain Rice Terraces', and 'Kaeru Island'. Enjoy the sounds of birds chirping, water flowing, frogs croaking, and waves crashing, and experience the true scenery of Kamitown.

title: ６月の香美町
description: Today marks the end of June. The rainy season began on June 10, and there have been many rainy days. The rice planting in the town has also finished, and for the rice fields, it can be said that the rain is a blessing. Additionally, it has become the season where we can see the sunset over Kasumi Coast. I would like to introduce a little bit of the scenery of Kōbichō in June. Please take a look at 'Kasumi Coast', 'Waiike no Ōkatsura', 'Uhe Mountain's Terraced Rice Fields', and 'Kaeru Island' from the location of the Kōbichō tourism poster shoot. Enjoy the scenery of Kōbichō as it is, with the sunset view, the sound of rain, and the chirping of birds.

title: ７月の香美町
description: July has come to an end. The rainy season has finally cleared on July 31, and it seems that hot summer is on its way. Please take care to avoid heatstroke. Here are a few glimpses of Kamitown's scenery in July. Please enjoy the views of 'Kasumi Coast', 'Oikeno Okatsura', 'Uhe Mountain's Terraced Rice Fields', and 'Kaeru Island' from the Kamitown tourism poster shooting locations. Enjoy the sunset scenery, the lights of fishing fires, the sound of evening cicadas, and the chirping of birds, all of which represent the true landscape of Kamitown.

title: ８月の香美町
description: August has come to an end, and September has finally arrived. In Kamitown, bottom trawling and Kasumi crab fishing have been lifted, making it a lively season at the fishing port. Here are a few glimpses of Kamitown's scenery in August. Please enjoy the views from the Kamitown tourism poster shooting locations: 'Kasumi Coast', 'Waiike's Great Katsura', 'Uhe Mountain's Terraced Rice Fields', and 'Kaeru Island'. Enjoy the summer-like blue sky, blue sea, lush green rice ears, and the sound of cicadas, which represent the true scenery of Kamitown.

title: ９月の香美町
description: As September comes to an end, October is finally here. The mornings and evenings have become cooler, and comfortable days continue. The rice harvesting in the town has begun, marking the season of fruitful autumn and appetizing autumn. Please enjoy the delicious ingredients of Kamitown. Here are a few glimpses of the scenery in Kamitown during September. From the locations of the Kamitown tourism posters, please take a look at 'Kasumi Coast', 'Waiike's Great Katsura', 'Uhe Mountain's Terraced Rice Fields', and 'Kaeru Island'. Enjoy the true scenery of Kamitown with the autumn-like blue sky, blue sea, harvested rice fields, and the chirping of birds.

title: １０月の香美町
description: October has come to an end, and November has arrived. The season for the opening of Matsuba crab fishing has finally begun. The trees in the mountains are starting to change color, and we are entering the peak of autumn foliage. Please come to Kamitown to enjoy its delicious ingredients and beautiful scenery.

title: １１月の香美町

The waves of the Sea of Japan are becoming rough, the trees in the mountains are shedding their leaves, and the first snow is likely to arrive soon. If you visit Kamitown, please come prepared with winter tires.

description:
🏔️ Welcome to Japan's 100 Famous Mountains, Norikura Mountain! Located on the border of Gifu and Nagano Prefectures, it belongs to Chubu Sangaku National Park, with its highest peak, Kengamine, standing at 3,026m. You can access Tatamidaira (2,702m) by bus, making it a popular choice for those looking to easily challenge a 3,000m-class mountain.

🌸 In summer, stroll through flower fields where alpine plants bloom, 
🌋 enjoy volcanic landscapes such as crater lakes and lava formations, 
🌅 and from the summit, take in the magnificent panorama of the Northern Alps, Hakusan, and Yatsugatake!

🚶‍♂️ There are plenty of courses suitable for beginner climbers! 
- It takes about 1 hour and 30 minutes one way to Kengamine 
- It takes just 15 minutes one way to the summit of Maou-dake

✨ "A mountain that is friendly to nature" = that is Norikura Mountain. It is a perfect mountain for beginners, enjoyable for both children and adults.

📹 In this video, we will thoroughly introduce the climbing routes, flower-filled meadows, and breathtaking views from the summit. Please watch until the end and use it as a reference for your next trip! 
*Even though it is accessible, please make sure to wear mountain-appropriate clothing and gear, and never neglect safety. Avoid climbing if you are sleep-deprived or unwell. Be cautious of altitude sickness as well.

description:
～Enjoy exploring the sacred place of nature, a hidden gem～
Goshikigahara, which spreads at the northwest foot of Mount Norikura in the Northern Alps, is a vast forest area of about 3000ha located at the southern end of Chubu Sangaku National Park. It is truly a hidden gem where rare untouched nature remains abundant.

With many streams, waterfalls, ponds, and wetlands originating from Mount Norikura, as well as various wild animals, birds, and insects, it is a spot where you can enjoy the diverse expressions of nature. Once you step in, you can feel the power of the great nature.

title: #飛騨高山 ふるさとの風景
description:
Gifu Prefecture Takayama City is an area rich in nature, surrounded by mountains over 3,000 meters high. In spring, new green buds sprout, in summer, the cool breeze of the highlands, in autumn, the colorful foliage, and in winter, the snow-covered landscape turns everything into a silver world—it's a place where you can fully experience the changing of the seasons.

The scenery spreading at the foot of the Northern Alps changes its expression every time you visit, leaving a deep impression in your heart. The clear air, the chirping of wild birds, and the sound of the wind passing through the trees... Time wrapped in the rhythm of nature makes you forget the hustle and bustle of daily life.

In spring, we enjoy the blooming weeping cherry blossoms, in summer, we cool off in the clear streams and greenery. In autumn, the mountains are dyed in golden and crimson colors, and in winter, a fantastic snowy landscape spreads out. No matter which season you visit, the beauty of each captivates travelers.

Moreover, not only nature but also the old townscape and the skills of artisans are one of the attractions of this area. Takayama, where nature and culture coexist, is a special place that gently heals the hearts of those who visit.

Take a journey to Hida Takayama to calm your mind. A quiet time with the seasons awaits you.

title: 五酒五感、#飛騨高山 で味わう極上の一杯
description: Gifu Prefecture's Takayama City. Surrounded by the Northern Alps, this city is known as a tourist destination rich in historical streets and natural blessings. However, did you know there is another charm? That is - 'sake.' In Takayama City, not only sake but also craft beer, whiskey, wine, and even rare lemon liqueur are locally produced, making it extremely rare to be able to taste five different types of 'local sake' in one city. Traditional sake brewed in a sake brewery that has been in operation since the Edo period. Craft beer made from local spring water and locally sourced malt. Fruity wine that takes advantage of the high-altitude climate. Fragrant liqueur made from highland-grown fruits. And uniquely flavored whiskey finished with meticulous distillation. Takayama City offers a rich sake culture where you can enjoy not only the sake itself but also the local climate, techniques, and the thoughts of the people behind it.

title: ReVIEW! #飛驒高山　高根町
description: Mamoru Kosaka, chairman of the Hida Takane Tourism Association, will introduce the charms of the town. Takane Town is located in the southeast of Takayama City, on a highland surrounded by nature overlooking Mt. Norikura and Mt. Ontake. Because it is adjacent to the Kiso region of Nagano Prefecture, its history, culture, and customs are strongly influenced by Kiso, and it is known as a foreign place even within Hida. Takane Town is also famous for being a production area for Kiso horses, and the stone Buddha statues made for memorial services for horses are filled with stories between people and horses. Takane Town is putting a lot of effort into fermented foods, and its whiskey distillery, which was repurposed from an abandoned school, is attracting a lot of attention. In addition, suna, which is pickled with lactic acid bacteria without using any salt, and country miso, which is often used in Hida's local cuisine, are also actively produced. The region's unique cool summers and cold winters are conducive to growing these fermented foods. It is also a unique place with many other attractions such as Hibata Soba, Takane Corn, Nomai Pass, and Mt. Ontake. Please come to Takane Town. (Approximately 50 minutes by car from Takayama city center)

title: ReVIEW!#飛騨高山 国府町
description: Mr. Iemitsu Kitamura, chairman of the Kokufu Tourism Association, will introduce the charms of the town. Kokufu Town is located in the northern part of Takayama City and is an area rich in history and nature. It has been a prosperous area since ancient times, with many cultural assets that can be seen, suggesting that it was the site of the Kokufu, the political center of Hidanokuni, over a thousand years ago. In this town, you can see many cultural assets and historical buildings, including many ancient tombs and excavated items from the Stone Age, as well as the Ankoku-ji Kyozo (national treasure) and the Enku Buddha handed down at Seiho-ji Temple, and is designated as a 'Japanese Heritage Site.' It also includes the cultural assets that make up the area. Through these things, you will feel a sense of nostalgia and warmth. It is also surrounded by beautiful mountains, allowing you to enjoy the scenery of each season. Especially in spring, the cherry blossoms in Sakurano Park are in full bloom, and the roads along the mountain village are dyed pink with peach blossoms, creating a beautiful scenery. This scenery is known as 'Peach Road' and is loved by locals. Furthermore, there are many waterfalls dotted around the Utsue Shijuhachi Falls, which have a water source at an altitude of 1,200m, and you can enjoy trekking and picnicking among the clear streams and forests. Your time here will soothe your soul. Please come to Kokufu Town. (About 20 minutes by car from downtown Takayama)

description: From the Meiji to Taisho era, the daughters who went to earn a living in distant Shinshu from the poor Hida traveled along the Nomugi Highway, which is home to 'Hida Takane'. It is a nature-rich area where you can see the northern end of Mt. Ontake, Mt. Kegusuko, and Mt. Norikura. There are many campsites that make use of the great outdoors, and beautiful autumn leaves can be enjoyed in the fall. Taking advantage of the cool highland environment even in summer, it is attracting attention as a place where athletes come to train. In addition, the indigenous variety 'Hibata Soba' cultivated in this climate is also popular! Why not visit Hida Takane?

title: ReVIEW! #飛驒高山　丹生川町
description: Senkoji Temple chief priest Mami Oshita will introduce the charm of the town. Nyukawa Town is a mountainous region located in the northeastern part of Takayama City. The town is symbolized by Mt. Norikura, one of Japan's 100 famous mountains. Although the mountain is 3,000 meters above sea level, you can take a bus to Tatamidaira, which is 2,702 meters high, so even children and women can easily experience the harsh world of mountains. From July to mid-August, a field of flowers spreads out in the sky right next to the bus terminal, and you can observe rare alpine plants. If you're lucky, you might even come across a grouse, a natural monument. Goshikigahara Forest spreads out at the foot of Mt. Norikura, Hida Great Limestone Cave is located at 900m, the highest tourist limestone cave in Japan, Nyukawa-cho, a town nestled in Mt. Norikura, has a variety of attractions, including the legend of Hida's hero, Ryōshuku-na, shrine visits, and a rural village with rich rural scenery. Please come to Shokawa Town. (Nyukawa Town is about 15 minutes by car from downtown Takayama / About 90 minutes walk from Tatamidaira to the summit of Mt. Norikura)

title: 秘境と神話が眠る町　#丹生川
description: Niu River Town, nestled at the southern end of the Northern Alps and Mount Norikura. Mount Norikura, home to the Japanese rock ptarmigan, allows you to easily experience the world of mountains. At its foot, Goshikigahara is home to a primeval forest, preserving a hidden sanctuary. Niu River Town is known for its production of tomatoes and spinach, with vegetables grown in water from the Northern Alps bursting with flavor. It is also a destination for cyclists, where the rural landscape and the breathtaking views of Mount Norikura captivate, energizing those pedaling. The changing scenery of the rural landscape through the seasons is a nostalgic treasure that we want to preserve for the future.

title: 城下町の面影薫る歴史と文化を凝縮した町　#飛騨高山
description: The city of Takayama retains a strong resemblance to its castle town past. The old streets that exude the atmosphere of the Edo period, the Takayama Jinya, the only remaining structure of the Tokugawa shogunate in the country, and the Kusakabe Folk Museum are just a few of the many historical buildings that remain in the city. It is also interesting to visit the sites associated with the warlord Nagachika Kanamori, who built the castle town and governed the domain from Takayama Castle, and reflect on the past.

title: せせらぎが聴こえる町　#飛騨清見
description: Surrounded by forests, Kiyomi Town, with its stylish cafes and restaurants, coexists with a sophisticated atmosphere and tranquil nature. The 'Hida Mino Seseragi Street', which runs north-south through the center of the town for a total length of 64 km, is an ideal driving route. Along the clear stream, fresh greenery shines in early summer. In autumn, it is known as a famous spot for autumn leaves, and the changing colors due to the elevation differences provide a long-lasting visual treat.

description: Sōkawa Town is surrounded by mountains and offers a view of the majestic 'Hakusan', which spans four prefectures: Toyama, Ishikawa, Fukui, and Gifu, located to the northwest of Sōkawa Town. You can enjoy beautiful seasonal scenery throughout the year, including cherry blossoms, fresh greenery, autumn leaves, and snowy landscapes.

description: Takayama City, the largest city in Japan, is full of attractions in every corner of the city. We will focus on and introduce the areas that make up Hida Takayama! We will delve into the various charms unique to Hida Takayama, including unknown anecdotes and experiences that can only be experienced in that location. Welcome to our town, Hida Takayama. Over a thousand years ago, Hida Kokufu flourished as the central "kokufu" of Hidanokuni. The land of the wind, where the wind smells and the wind colors. A land of soil where the scent of soil and the color of soil change. A village of the seasons, where the scent of the seasons and the colors of the seasons change. If you follow Hidaji to the north, you will find Hida Kokufu, a nostalgic village filled with warmth. Even though it's my first time visiting this place, I feel strangely nostalgic for some reason. As you explore the history, folk customs, and nature that are so reminiscent of Japan's original landscape, you will feel like you can understand why the Kokufu was established in this area.

title: 天下の名城 高山城 ⑥大手道、金森将監屋敷(2023.1.13変更)
description: In the 14th year of Tenmei (1586), Kanamori Nagachika became the lord of Hida Province. We will explore the appearance of Takayama Castle, which he built, from the current townscape. The guide is Akira Tanaka, who has been involved in historical research and excavation in the Hida region for many years and serves as a specialist in compiling the Takayama City History.

title: #飛騨高山 #新伝統工芸 #iPhone ケース制作
description:
The skills of artisans that still thrive in Hida Takayama. The techniques of knowing wood, manipulating lacquer, and utilizing clay and stone in daily life have been passed down as 'skills' and have eventually come to be called 'artisans.' These techniques continue to be inherited and refined today. Furthermore, in line with modern lifestyles, 'new traditional crafts' are being created in new forms that inherit the skills of Hida's artisans. They hold new possibilities for traditional crafts that go beyond trends and novelty.

Introducing Hida's new traditional crafts 'Nocturne,' which proposes the skills and spirit of 'Hida's artisans' in line with modern lifestyles. Nocturne creates products that align with contemporary lifestyles, breaking away from conventional concepts, using traditional crafts such as Hida Shunkei, Ichii Ittobori, and Yamanaka Washi, and is gaining a new user base. Among them, the highlight is the smartphone case (iPhone 14) designed in collaboration with Washizuka Sculpture, featuring the Ichii Ittobori design that fits comfortably in hand. Made from natural wood, it features a design that utilizes the wood grain. The case design is committed to closely following the shape of the smartphone itself, and the woodworking techniques of Nocturne and the artisan skills of Ichii Ittobori allow for a perfect fit without distortion. I am grateful to the friends here who taught me this way of enjoying effort.

The Western-style building is connected to a Japanese-style building, a storehouse, and a pond-style garden, all of which have largely retained their original appearance since construction. Both the Western and Japanese buildings are designated as important cultural properties of the country.

This beach, which gracefully receives the rough waves of the Kuroshio, is a beautiful coastline lined with round pebbles polished by the rough waves of Kumano Nada.

title: 「楯ヶ崎」　海に突き立てられた巨大な楯のような大岩壁は圧倒的な迫力です！
description:
Tategasaki, designated as a natural monument in Mie Prefecture, is a massive rock wall that juts out into the sea like a giant shield! (Height: about 80m, Circumference: about 550m)

The columnar jointing, which looks like countless pillars lined up, was formed by the cooling and solidification of a large amount of magma during a massive volcanic activity about 14 million years ago. While columnar jointing can be seen all along the coast of Kumano, Tategasaki stands independently and presents a breathtaking view!

It is also ideal for hiking, with a well-maintained walking path in the Tategasaki Park. The path from National Route 311 at the entrance to Tategasaki takes about 40 minutes one way, and along the way, there is the rare Akoshi Shrine, which connects to the sea. Along the walking path, you can find plants unique to Kumano, and special plants have explanatory tree labels installed, allowing you to enjoy a moderate hike while learning about the plants in a forest bathing experience.

For those who want to enjoy a more dynamic view, there are also sightseeing boats available.

Nearby, Kawamura Zuiken Park's southern slope blooms with Kawazu cherry blossoms in late February, heralding the arrival of spring.

title: 英虞湾(夕景)【ドローン撮影】(志摩市)｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: The beautiful scenery of Japan's renowned ria coastline, Ago Bay, is the home of pearls. As the sun sets, the numerous capes, islands, and floating pearl rafts are enveloped in a golden hue, captivating all who witness the beauty of the sunset.

title: 御在所岳(紅葉)　【ドローン撮影】(菰野町)｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: The main peak of the Suzuka Mountains, Gozaisho Mountain stands at an elevation of 1,212 meters. At the foot of the mountain is Yunoyama Onsen, and a world-class ropeway connects to the summit, offering a wonderful aerial walk. The autumn leaves begin around mid-October from the summit, descending to the middle and then to the foot of the mountain, including Yunoyama Onsen, over the course of about a month.

title: 大杉谷渓谷：シシ渕ニコニコ滝　ドローン映像（三重県大台町）｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: One of Japan's three great valleys, Ōsugidani. The emerald green hidden area is gaining popularity. This is a drone video shot of Shishibuchi and Nikonikodaki. (Video provided by Haru Isaka, Ōdaichō Regional Revitalization Cooperation Team)

title: 丸山千枚田（三重県熊野市）～“日本の棚田百選”にも選ばれた息をのむ曲線美｜【公式】観光三重
description: Registered as a 'Future Heritage' project by the Japan UNESCO Association and selected as one of Japan's top 100 terraced rice fields, Maruyama Senmaida in Kumano City, Mie Prefecture. There are always people supporting beautiful landscapes and tourist attractions. This time, we visited those involved in the restoration and preservation of 'Maruyama Senmaida' to learn about the beauty behind it.

title: 鵜倉園地（うぐらえんち）ドローン映像（三重県南伊勢町）｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: You can enjoy the beautiful view of the ria coast unique to Ise-Shima National Park. There are four observation decks: Akebono Observatory, Mie Island Observatory, Kasaragi Observatory, and Tachibana Observatory. From Akebono Observatory, you can see the Parent-Child Bridge, and from Mie Island Observatory, you can see the heart-shaped inlet designated as a 'Sacred Place for Lovers' on April 1, 2015.

title: 大杉谷渓谷：堂倉滝　ドローン映像（三重県大台町）｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: One of Japan's three great valleys, Osugidani. The emerald green hidden area is gaining popularity. This is a video shot with a drone of Doukurataki.

title: 浦村の牡蠣（三重県鳥羽市）｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: In Toba City, Mie Prefecture, the recommended specialty in winter is oysters! This video features the oysters from the Urakamura area of Toba City, which have become famous through television and other media. The picturesque Urakamura area, which has been celebrated in many songs since ancient times, is home to many oyster farms. In this area, there are plenty of restaurants where you can enjoy nutritious oysters, often referred to as the milk of the sea! Additionally, many establishments offer service menus such as fried oysters, oyster rice, and preserved oysters when dining, so be sure to check them out.

title: 三重県大台町の紅葉ドローン映像｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: One of Japan's three great valleys, 'Osugidani' is located in Odaicho, Mie Prefecture. Odaicho, rich in nature, has many beautiful spots for autumn leaves. Enjoy the autumn leaf footage captured by drone.

title: 松阪市総合運動公園スケートパーク（三重県松阪市）｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: Mie Prefecture's first public skate park! A skate park with the largest area in the country has been established in Matsusaka City, where beginners to advanced skaters can enjoy. It is divided into three attractive areas: competition area, local area, and pool area, each offering different ways to have fun. For beginners, schools are also held, so you can enjoy it with peace of mind.

title: 大自然満喫！香肌峡でカヌー体験（松阪市）｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: We had a canoe experience at Kahadakyo in Matsusaka City, where families can enjoy together! The canoe experience at Kahadakyo, where you can fully enjoy nature, is a recommended leisure activity that can be enjoyed with family, friends, or couples, even for beginners. You can play for a full 2 hours and leisurely enjoy nature. How about trying a canoe experience on the beautiful Kushida River surrounded by green mountains?

title: 伊勢忍者キングダム（伊勢安土桃山城下町）で「忍者　森のアドベンチャー」を体験！（伊勢市）｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: A theme park where you can experience history and culture with ninja and townspeople bustling around the townscape centered on Azuchi Castle. You can enjoy live performances such as the ninja action show 'Great Ninja Theater' and the emotional 'Yamada Magistrate's Office'. The athletic 'Ninja Forest Adventure' is a big hit for families. Be sure to change into ninja costumes with a pass and take on the challenge!

title: 抜群の透明度！奇跡の川と呼ばれる銚子川（紀北町）｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: Japan's top-notch transparency allows you to see the bottom of the river without diving, and you can clearly see the fish swimming. This river in Kihoku Town is sometimes called the Miracle River due to its consistent high transparency from upstream to downstream.

title: 孫太郎オートキャンプ場をちょっとお散歩してきました(紀北町)｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: Kii Nagashima Interchange on the Kisei Expressway is just a 10-minute drive away. Magotaro Auto Campground, located in Kihoku Town, Kitamuro District, Mie Prefecture, is a nature-rich auto campground surrounded by the sea and mountains. The tent sites are broadly divided into two types: 'tent sites' and 'seaside cottages', with the tent sites further divided into A sites, B sites, C sites, D sites, and free sites. You can also fish right in front of the campground. Kayaking and SUP tours are available, allowing you to experience various activities.

title: 東海道関宿～伝統を受け継ぐ～(亀山市)｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: Sekijuku, the 47th post town of the Tokaido Fifty-Three Stations, flourished and still retains the atmosphere of the time. More than 200 townhouses built from the late Edo period to the Meiji period still exist here, and it has been designated as an Important Preservation District for Groups of Traditional Buildings and selected as one of Japan's 100 Roads. Through the people who have inherited the old traditions, we introduce the charm of 'Sekijuku'.

title: フォレストアドベンチャー湯の山(菰野町)・ダブルジップスライド体験｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: Mie Prefecture's first Forest Adventure opened in Komono Town on March 16, 2019! I experienced the final course, the Double Zip Slide. It's a fun attraction where families, friends, and couples can share the exhilaration and sense of achievement together!

title: 熊野大花火大会2018(熊野市)スターマイン（１）｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: This is a video of the star mine at the Kumano Grand Fireworks Festival. The fireworks that cannot fit into the field of view are spectacular!

description: Have you already decided on your summer vacation plans? Various fun events are lined up throughout Mie Prefecture! We will introduce recommended spots.

title: ナガシマジャンボ海水プール「ジャパーーーーン」(桑名市)｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: I experienced the shock of the popular attraction 'Japan' at Nagashima Jumbo Sea Water Pool! Water flows down from a height of about 18m, and the popular 'Japan' features a giant bucket weighing about 3 tons at the top of the tower, along with two other giant buckets, totaling a weight of 6 tons of water that flows down all at once!

title: ナガシマジャンボ海水プール ビッグワンスライダーに乗りました♪｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: I rode the Big One Slider at Nagashima Jumbo Sea Water Pool! It's a slider where you can experience a rapid descent on a four-person rubber boat. Feel the thrill of the Big One Slider!

title: 志摩地中海村をご紹介(志摩市)｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: A resort with experience and stay type featuring white-walled buildings modeled after Mediterranean architecture. You will be captivated by extraordinary experiences such as a new area inspired by Mykonos, Menorca, and Alhambra, as well as a natural hot spring with Arabic design (for accommodation only). We invite you to visit the exotic town of Shima Mediterranean Village.

title: 伊勢忍者キングダム(旧伊勢安土桃山城下街)(伊勢市)｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: The 'Ninja Technique! Musasabi no Jutsu' has appeared, allowing you to zip through the wide grounds of the Ise Azuchi Momoyama Castle Town connected by wires! You can enjoy the feeling of being a ninja as you dash through the sky in a ninja costume. It was introduced by the castle town actors Yasushi Saito and Hiroshi Ito.

title: 飛雪の滝キャンプ場 ダッキー(カヤック)体験(紀宝町)｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: I experienced Duckie at Hiyuki no Taki Campground in Kihō Town, Mie Prefecture! It's a thrilling and fun activity that involves plunging into the waterfall pool!

title: 冬の御在所岳【ドローン撮影】(菰野町)｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: Mie Prefecture's only ski resort, 'Gozaisho Mountain'. It's perfect for those who want to enjoy skiing as well as those who want a little snow mountain experience. Take the Gozaisho Ropeway from the foot of Yunoyama Onsen and enter a world of silver.

title: 英虞湾【ドローン撮影】(志摩市)｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: Ago Bay, the hometown of pearls, boasts the beauty of one of Japan's leading ria coasts. From January to April, it welcomes the season for cultivating aonori seaweed, dyeing the clear sea with green mats of seaweed, marking the arrival of spring. For a view of Ago Bay, the Yokoyama Observatory in Shima City is recommended. It was renovated in 2018, and a 'Sky Cafe Terrace' has been created!

title: 伊賀流忍者博物館「忍術実演ショー」動画：「くノ一」戦闘シーン(伊賀市)｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: The Ninjutsu demonstration show at the Iga-ryu Ninja Museum is a must-see for ninja enthusiasts! The combat scene of the female ninja 'Kunoichi' is also full of impact! Agile, brave, and beautiful, it will leave you breathless.

title: 伊賀流忍者博物館「忍術実演ショー」動画：九字護身法(伊賀市)｜観光三重｜三重県の観光・旅行情報
description: The ninjutsu demonstration show at the Iga-ryu Ninja Museum is a must-see for ninja enthusiasts! The performance of the spell 'Nine Character Protection Method' is filled with a solemn atmosphere as the practitioners unify their minds and chant incantations, creating a sense of tension. This is followed by a display of brave swordsmanship. Real swords are used!

title: 【Full HD】志摩スペイン村　ピレネー最前列【1080p】
description: I rode in the front row of the roller coaster 'Pyrenees' at Shima Spain Village, perfect for roller coaster lovers! Enjoy the thrilling footage! *Filmed with special permission.

title: 伊賀忍者フェスタ2018
description: Iga Ninja Festival 2018 will be held from April 7 (Saturday) to May 6 (Tuesday) in Iga City, Mie Prefecture, a famous event in the land of ninjas! This spring, why not become a ninja and stroll through the castle town adorned with cherry blossoms?

title: 島ヶ原温泉やぶっちゃ
description: Shimagahara Onsen Yabuccha is located in a beautiful natural setting in the mountains along the upper Kizu River in Iga City, Mie Prefecture, where you can enjoy leisure activities such as auto camping, day camping, tennis, and ground golf. After playing, you can refresh yourself in the mineral-rich natural hot springs.

title: なばなの里イルミネーション（三重県桑名市）
description: The illumination at 'Nabana no Sato' in Kuwana City, Mie Prefecture, is world-renowned and popular.

description: Autumn is in full swing. Here are some recommended spots in Mie Prefecture to visit in November.

title: 観光三重2017 100号記念　10月のオススメ観光20セレクション
description: Autumn is in full swing. We introduce recommended spots in Mie Prefecture that will be held in October.

title: 氏郷まつり
description: A grand festival celebrating Lord Ushigō Gamō will be held in Matsusaka City, Mie Prefecture on November 3rd. A procession of about 200 warriors, including Lord Ushigō Gamō, Winter Princess, armored samurai, and a gun squad, will march through the town. There will also be a lively market and stage events.

title: 円座・佐八かんこ踊り
description: Kanko Odori is a Bon festival event (designated as an intangible folk cultural asset by the prefecture) where participants wear a jaguma made from the tail of a white horse, beat drums, and dance in a circle around a bonfire. The sight of dancers beating drums while dancing around the torch is captivating.

title: 植木神社祇園祭
description: The festival consists of the evening festival and the procession of the deity, featuring a magnificent float that has been cherished since the Edo period and a powerful portable shrine that parades through the town. The lively festival, centered around the 'Kuneri' where the portable shrine is tilted and the procession of Gion flowers, attracts many spectators.

title: ざるやぶり神事
description: A festival that has been passed down for about 450 years. Young men in fundoshi compete for a zaru, about 90 cm in diameter, which contained rice offerings presented before the gods. The sight of them colliding and grappling to tear the zaru apart is truly spectacular.

title: 「みえ食旅パスポート」で三重県を美味しく旅しよう！
description: This is an introduction video about the Mie Food Travel Passport.

title: ミキモト真珠島
description: In 1893, Kokichi Mikimoto succeeded in the world's first pearl cultivation on this island. During the summer vacation, you can take commemorative photos wearing a pearl tiara in the event 'Transform into Elegance with a Pearl Tiara' or participate in workshops like 'Strap Workshop' and 'Kaleidoscope Workshop' using freshwater pearls.

title: 伊勢・安土桃山文化村
description: The haunted house that uses the entire Azuchi Castle is only here! It is a hellish scene of agony and despair, where you will be tormented by raging flames. Will you be able to escape safely from the haunted Azuchi Castle, where commands are given to visitors?

title: 伊勢志摩エバーグレイズ
description: An outdoor space that fuses 'comfort, relaxation, and elegance' into a high-quality glamping experience. Enjoy a private canoe on a dedicated course, and experience authentic American BBQ for dinner.

title: 熊野大花火大会
description: About 10,000 powerful fireworks will be launched. The grand finale features the large-scale fireworks from the rocky areas and caves of Onigajo, creating a powerful performance as the explosion sounds resonate off the rocks.

title: 松阪祇園まつり
description: In the afternoon of the evening festival, the 'three shrine mikoshi' from Matsusaka, Mikuriya, and Yakumo parade through the town with 1,000 men and women of all ages in matching happi coats, shouting 'Chosaya'. Today, dances such as 'Matsusaka Shongai Ondo' and stage events will be showcased.

title: しだれ梅が見事な津市の結城神社へ行ってきました

description: The night view from the top of Mount Gozaisyo is also impressive. For a limited time, the Gozaisyo Ropeway will operate night service. Please go out for a slightly romantic aerial walk that is different from the daytime.

title: 史跡斎宮跡
description: The Saiku, where the Saio, who served the goddess Amaterasu of Ise Jingu on behalf of the Emperor, lived. Around the historical site, there are spots related to the world of Saiku, which was considered a phantom palace, including 'Saiku Heian no Mori,' which has restored three buildings of the Saiku Ryocho from the Heian period.

title: 道の駅紀宝町ウミガメ公園
description: A base for sea turtle protection and awareness activities that conducts research and breeding of sea turtles. You can enjoy interacting with sea turtles and other creatures living around Kihō-cho. The feeding experience for sea turtles is also popular.

title: 世界遺産 巡礼路「熊野古道伊勢路」 ～映像シリーズ１
description: Since ancient times, the Japanese have believed that gods reside in all things and have revered nature... The sun god, Amaterasu Omikami, is enshrined at Ise Jingu. Here, we pray for a safe journey and begin our trip to Kumano. The Ise Road stretches approximately 170 kilometers from Ise to Kumano, crossing many mountain passes with various faces and expressions. The Kumano Kodo is an ancient road that pilgrims walked to reach the three Kumano shrines (Kumano Hayatama Taisha, Kumano Nachi Taisha, Kumano Hongu Taisha) located in Wakayama Prefecture from various parts of Japan. This is a world heritage pilgrimage route that connects the two major sacred sites of Japan, Ise Jingu and the Kumano Sanzan, and we will introduce its history and charm.

title: 世界遺産 巡礼路「熊野古道伊勢路」 ～映像シリーズ２
description: The pilgrimage path is home to people who respect their ancestors and cherish nature...
