description: I experienced the famous 'Iga Kumihimo' making and Iga pottery experience in Iga City! This time, I will report on these two activities. The model is Natsumi Kakutani, Miss Tsu Queen 2016. For detailed report, click here: https://www.kankomie.or.jp/report/detail_178.html

title: かわいいイルカたちにも会える「鳥羽湾めぐりとイルカ島」　その１
description: Enjoy a luxurious cruise around Toba Bay! You can also meet cute dolphins at 'Toba Bay Cruise and Dolphin Island'. An article is published on the Kankomie HP report. Please take a look.

title: かわいいイルカたちにも会える「鳥羽湾めぐりとイルカ島」その２
description: Enjoy a luxurious cruise in Toba Bay! A report on the tour where you can meet cute dolphins, 'Toba Bay Tour and Dolphin Island,' is published on the Mie Tourism website. Please take a look.

title: 志摩マリンランド　ペンギンタッチ（観光三重）
description: I experienced the popular Penguin Touch at Shima Marin Land. Here is the article about Shima Marin Land!

title: 志摩マリンランド　ドクターフィッシュ
description: I experienced Doctor Fish at Shima Marinland. Here is the article about Shima Marinland!

title: 四日市コンビナート夜景クルーズ
description: Yokkaichi, a sacred place for factory night views representing Japan. A veteran guide accompanies you, showcasing not only the jewel-like factory night views but also the night view of Chubu Centrair International Airport in the distance. In particular, the fantastical night view of the first complex is breathtakingly beautiful.

title: 鈴鹿の森庭園
description: A famous plum blossom spot that captivates photographers. It features 200 weeping plum trees, including the representative Gofuku Shidare variety, expertly cultivated by renowned artisans.

title: 伊賀流忍者博物館
description: Iga Ueno Castle and the Haisei Hall are among the many famous spots in Ueno Park. The museum features guides who explain the tricks and mechanisms of ninja houses, including flips and other techniques. In the Ninja Experience Plaza, you can also enjoy thrilling ninja performance shows.

title: 伊賀のかくれ宿　湯元赤目温泉隠れの湯　対泉閣
description: This ryokan is located at the entrance of Akame Valley, just a 5-minute walk from the Akame Forty-eight Waterfalls. You can enjoy high-quality alkaline simple hot springs certified by the Japanese therapeutic hot spring regulations, as well as local cuisine featuring Iga beef.

title: 松阪まるよし（三重県松阪市）
description: Using the exquisite loin that can only be obtained from about 600 kg of beef, we offer Matsusaka beef loin steak with a tender texture and irresistible sweetness, as well as Matsusaka beef round steak, which was born from the desire to enjoy a lighter meal.

title: ありすえ
description: Ise maguro sashimi, fried bloodline, akami yukke, and heart tsukudani are enjoyed in different textures and flavors, allowing you to savor the Ise maguro from the Minami-Ise brand. It's also delightful to encounter local flavors like the heart, which are hard to find elsewhere.

title: 一度は観てみたい！三重の絶景・木津呂・英虞湾・鬼ヶ城｜観光三重
description: We introduce the stunning views of Mie Prefecture through drone footage.

title: スペイン村の新エンターテイメント・ストリートミュージカル☆
description: Shima Spain Village Parque Espana's street musical 'Enciero! ~UNO! DOS! TRES! MOOH! A slightly different cow chasing festival!~'

title: 御在所岳で 初日の出
description: This is a video of the first sunrise I saw at the summit park of Gozaisho Mountain after taking the Gozaisho Ropeway on New Year's Day 2013.

title: 鈴鹿サーキット・バットのクリスタルハント「バットの探検隊団結式」
description: Adventure-type shooting attraction ☆ Suzuka Circuit's 'Bat's Crystal Hunt' participatory event 'Bat Exploration Team Unity Ceremony'.

title: 鈴鹿サーキットの新アトラクション☆バットのパワークリスタルハント
description: Adventure-type shooting attraction, Bat's Power Crystal Hunt at Suzuka Circuit.

title: 御在所岳・スキーゲレンデ
description: Gozaisho Mountain Ski Resort

title: 紀北のたび
description: Kihoku Town Kii Nagashima District Furusato's hot springs and seafood are fully enjoyed!!!

title: 紀和の雲海
description: Kiwa no Unkai

title: ぐるぐる鬼ヶ城
description: The weather was nice, so I drove along the Shichiri Mihama coast and went around Onigajo. The large rocks were impressive, and the Kumano Sea was beautiful.

title: 河内渓谷の紅葉は最高！
description: On November 18, 2011, I went out with my family to Kawachi Valley in Geino Town, Tsu City. The autumn leaves were wonderful, and the maple trees were dyed bright red. A volunteer guide taught us about the highlights.

title: 伊勢志摩スカイライン
description: I went on a picnic with my family of three to Ise-Shima Skyline with a bento. The view from the foot bath was excellent, and I felt great in the hammock.

title: 関宿・旧街道 夜の町並み
description: I walked through the night townscape of the old Tōkaidō in Kanyashuku. It was a very lovely street that was softly illuminated in warm colors, allowing me to feel the history.

title: 夫婦岩
description: This is a family trip to Toba and Ise in Mie Prefecture. We visited Couple Rock.

title: アカトンボふる里さがし大作戦！
description: I went to Mount Gozaisho and participated in the Akatombo Furusato Search Operation. Although there was sunlight, the wind made the shade very refreshing. Due to the influence of the wind from the previous day, it was said that the number of dragonflies was low that day, but the children ran around and managed to catch 9 dragonflies and mark them with a 'G'. It became a fun summer memory.

title: 志摩スペイン村～アトラクション・パレード・花火～
description: I visited Shima Spain Village. It's fun to participate in the parade with characters and dancers. I thoroughly enjoyed Parque Espana for two days.

title: 大内山動物園とプライムリゾート賢島
description: I went to Ouchiyama Zoo with my family. The children were very happy to feed various kinds of animals. At the hotel, we enjoyed wonderful cuisine and experienced a resort atmosphere.

title: 福王神社～福王山～東海自然歩道コース 山歩き
description: This is a video of my hike up Fukuou Mountain (elevation 597m) in Komono Town. It was my second time at Fukuou Mountain, but I recently learned about a course that allows you to go around by descending to the Tokai Nature Trail on the opposite side of Fukuou Shrine, and I was looking forward to it with a fresh mindset. It was very hot, but I was able to spend a healing time with the sounds of cicadas and insects, and the air of the mountains and forests.

title: IN TOYAMA short ver.
description: 観光体験できる映像を。

title: 御在所
description: I took the ropeway (length 2161m) to the top of Gozaisho Mountain. The highest support pillar of the ropeway is the tallest in Japan at 61m. The temperature in the city was 35 degrees, while at the summit at an altitude of 1212m, it was a cool 24 degrees, and many red dragonflies were flying around.

title: なばなの里～シロモチくんといっしょ～
description: I went to Nabana no Sato with Shiromochi-kun. It was beautiful! It was a dream world.

title: 電車が動いた！
description: I went to a Kintetsu railway event in Shiohama with my family. It was fun to look under the train and to operate it. During the tug-of-war, the train moved!

title: 2012年ローズフェア開催中！
description: The English Garden's rose garden is in full bloom with 1,600 roses of 107 varieties. Enjoy an elegant moment in the garden filled with the sweet fragrance of roses. (The best viewing time is expected around the end of May)

title: 搾乳体験ワクワクだー
description: I went to the 'Spring Exciting Interaction Festival' at Yokkaichi City Interaction Farm. I was excited yet a bit nervous about my first milking experience. With the careful guidance of an uncle, I was able to do it well! Thank you, Kinako-chan (the name of the cow)! It was a fun day.

title: 四日市萬古まつり
description: The Banko Festival was held around Banko Shrine in Toyocho, Yokkaichi City.

title: 伊賀上野NINJAフェスタで忍者に変身
description: I went to the Iga Ueno NINJA Festival 2012. I borrowed a ninja costume and transformed into a ninja, enjoying Iga Ueno Castle, the Ninja House, and a ninja show. I was surprised to see so many ninjas in the city even on a weekday.

title: ぼたんまつり
description: I went to Inabe to see the peonies. They were beautiful. There was a large park with mini-golf.

title: ナガシマスパーランドの全景！
description: This is an overview of Nagashima Spa Land, including the scaled-up Kid's Town!

title: 大内山動物園でほのぼの癒されました
description: It was my first time at Ouchiyama Zoo. Friendly goats and ponies, mischievous monkeys... surprisingly cat-like tigers, and the day flew by in no time. It was a memorable day of fun.

title: 鈴鹿サーキット
description: I went to the Suzuka Circuit, which celebrated its 50th anniversary during spring break. There are many attractions that even a 2-year-old can enjoy, and we played until closing time. The 'Bunbun Pancake Shop' is a favorite among the kids.

title: 子どもがおおはしゃぎ！大内山動物園に行ってきました
description: We went to Ouchiyama Zoo. It was beautiful, perhaps because it was renovated. There were many animals, and small children were having a great time! I was surprised to learn that tigers eat grass along with meat.

title: 馬越峠
description: I walked the Makigoe Pass of the Kumano Kodo. The sound of the bush warblers echoes in the fresh greenery.

title: 自分みがきスポット三重 -尾鷲版-
description: The World Heritage Site 'Kumano Kodo - Ise Road' connects Ise to the Kumano Sanzan and is a pilgrimage route mentioned in history. If you walk while imagining the travelers of old, you will surely be captivated by its depth. The 'Yume Kodo Owase' offers a recommended lunch buffet by the local mothers!

title: 自分みがきスポット三重 -南伊勢版-
description: Experience a slow life with the rich nature of Minami-Ise Town! The scenic spot, Heart Bay, is popular among couples and women wishing for love fulfillment! At Asai-san's house of Minami-Ise Kirari Interaction Association, you can enjoy a sea bream salt-baked experience using local sea bream.

title: 自分みがきスポット三重 -伊賀版-
description: You can see, taste, and even create pottery! Enjoy valuable registered tangible cultural properties, including Iga-yaki shops, climbing kilns used since the Edo period, retro buildings, and furnishings at the precious Taisho-kan. Satisfy yourself with a lohas time away from everyday life!

title: 自分みがきスポット三重 -津版-
description: Nostalgia invites you to Izakurai Town! Stroll through a town full of emotion with Japan's only moat, traditional townhouses, and storehouses. There are many cultural properties designated by the country and prefecture, such as the Mikagedo and Nyorai-do in Senshu-ji, and the Treasure Museum, making it a must-visit spot for history lovers!

title: 自分みがきスポット三重-ダイジェスト版-
description: The charm of the guided tour! In Mie, there are many guides who love the local area, know it well, and convey its charm in a fun way. Let's embark on a journey of self-discovery with these guides to find a new version of ourselves!

title: 夜桜を見てきたでござるの巻
description: I went to see the night cherry blossoms at 'Kairaku Park', a famous cherry blossom spot within a 5-minute walk from Tsu Station in Tsu City, Mie Prefecture.

title: 花より・・・
description: It was a nice day, so I went out with my child to Kairaku Park in Tsu City. The flowers were blooming beautifully.

title: ３６０度の光のトンネル！
description: I went to Nabana no Sato. However, it was raining on that day. I was feeling down, but the warm light arches of the illumination reflected on the ground, creating a 360-degree light tunnel! It was very beautiful.

title: ミキモト真珠島美しい海女さん
description: I went to Mikimoto Pearl Island and watched the ama show. It was amazing. By the way, it was a warm day, but the sea looked cold. I heard they do it even in winter.

title: 石神さんに行ったついでにお宝発見
description: I went to Ishigami-san in Toba. On the way back, while walking towards the port, I saw a fisherman taking a large Ise lobster from the net and carefully storing it. It's big! I want to try it!

title: 輪中の郷のジャガイモ掘り
description: I experienced potato digging in Wajima, Nagashima-cho, Kuwana City. The weather was favorable, and I was satisfied to be able to enjoy harvesting potatoes. Since they were grown organically without pesticides, I enjoyed them deliciously after returning home.

title: オレ、カンパチ
description: I went fishing on a charter boat in Toba. Despite the high waves, we caught a lot of beautiful sea bream, yellowtail, and kanpachi. My two sons, who love meat, said the fish was tastier than meat.

title: みえのみどころええとこ☆なばなの里 ウインターイルミネーション
description: Mie no Midokoro eetoko no shuzai de, Nabana no Sato Winter Illumination ni itte kimashita. Chijou 45m no Airando Fuji kara no yakkei desu. Sukēru kan no aru kandou to odoroki no irumi neeshon ga osusume☆

title: さるびの温泉にいってきました
description: I went to Sarubino Onsen! It was wonderful to relax in the hot spring after a long time.

title: 一人前？
description: I went to Mie Children's Castle in Matsusaka. My child tried rock climbing for the first time! As for me...

title: ◆もくもく収穫祭◆
description: I took this photo when I went to Mokumoku Handmade Farm. They were holding a harvest festival event, and the 'Livestock Chase Derby' was incredibly fun! Everyone was excited♪

title: みえのみどころええとこ・鳥羽市相差の海女小屋体験
description: In the coverage of Mie no Midokoro Eetoko, I experienced the Ama Goya. The stories from the Ama were really wonderful. This interaction made the seafood even more delicious!

title: 元気いっぱい（＾O＾）♪安濃津よさこい！！☆津まつり☆
description: I went to see the energetic Anotsu Yosakoi (＾＾) I was so moved by the synchronized performance that I even shed tears (＊＾＾＊) My little daughter was also dancing with her bottom shaking☆

title: 近っ！ナガスパのスチールドラゴン
description: I went to Jazz Dream Nagashima, which has grown larger. I was very satisfied! The Steel Dragon at Nagashima Spa Land passes right by, and it's full of excitement.

title: 鳥羽水族館ってすごい
description: I visited Toba Aquarium for the first time. It's big, has a lot of variety, and is beautiful. Also, the sea lion show, with the sea lions' tricks and the staff's talk, was the best. The kids were very happy!

title: 福王神社に参拝しました！
description: I visited Fukuou Shrine. For lunch, I went to Komono Fuji and had a meal. The view was great, and the scenery was the best.

title: 松阪牛おいしいよ～
description: Matsusaka beef, which is representative of Japanese beef, can be enjoyed in Mie Prefecture. Mie Prefecture is a gourmet paradise with seafood and mountain delicacies. It is a treasure trove of attractions beyond just sightseeing and shopping.

title: 輪中ドームの横でターザン
description: This is a scene where children are having fun and playing enthusiastically at the Kiso-Sankawa Park Culture Village when visiting the circular village.

title: パルケエスパーニャのナイトパレード
description: The night parade is beautiful and fun. The finale fireworks were impressive as they were seen up close.

title: 志摩スペイン村パルケエスパーニャ・夜のピレネーはめっちゃ最高です
description: I went to Shima Spain Village. Riding the Pyrenees during the day is fun, but riding it at night is absolutely amazing! I'm hooked.

title: ミキモト真珠島の海女さんのショー
description: I saw the Ama show at Mikimoto Pearl Island. The gorgeous pearl crafts are simply amazing. Moreover, the Ama show was very interesting.

title: ナガシマスパーランド花火
description: I went to see the fireworks at Nagashima Spa Land. They were spectacular, and I definitely want to go see them again next year!

title: 青山高原の風車群と雄大な眺め
description: I went to see the wind turbines at Aoyama Plateau with my child. It was a gentle breeze, so we were taking a break. It was a bit cloudy, but the view from the sea to the mountains was magnificent.

title: 恋こ槌
description: Staying at Sakakibara Onsen. The hot springs and Koi no Tsuchi are the main attractions.

title: メナード青山リゾートでゆったりのんびり
description: I went to Menard Aoyama Resort with my family. We spent a relaxing time in the cool highlands. The wood crafts were cute. I want to go again.

title: 夫婦岩
description: Many people came to worship.

title: 「カメだよー！」
description: I recently went to the Futami Sea Paradise with my friend's children. The kids were thrilled to see the big turtle for the first time♪

title: 暑い日にはやっぱりしらざけやのかき氷
description: Every summer, I crave Shirazakeya's shaved ice. I visited Kasuga-taisha Shrine and ordered the special. I'm full.

title: ナローゲージのキュートな電車
description: I rode the Hokusei Line when I returned home. It was the train I took every day in high school. Narrow gauge trains are really rare and precious. It was a cute little train that went along with a clattering sound.

title: 鈴鹿サーキットの花火大会
description: I went to the Suzuka Circuit Fireworks Festival again this year. It was impressive to see it up close. It was beautiful☆.。.:*・゜

title: 出番待ち
description: I went to the Yokkaichi Festival. It was bustling with a lot of people. While wandering around, I discovered a giant creature waiting for its turn. The way its neck stretches will have to wait until next year.

title: 海女小屋体験
description: Recently, I experienced the ama hut in Osozu, Toba!

title: 四日市港ポートビル＠四日市コンビナート夜景クルーズ
description:
To cover the attractions of Mie, I recently went on the Yokkaichi Industrial Complex Night View Cruise. The article is here → http://www.kankomie.or.jp/mMidokoro/detail_77_0.html

I saw various tourist spots, took a cruise to see the factory night view, and finally enjoyed the night view from the 100-meter-high Yokkaichi Port Tower. It was a very fantastic and wonderful sight!

title: 四日市コンビナート夜景クルーズ
description:
To cover the attractions of Mie, I recently went on the Yokkaichi Industrial Complex Night View Cruise. Article is here → http://www.kankomie.or.jp/mMidokoro/detail_77_0.html

The factory night view seen from the boat, which is usually not visible, was incredibly beautiful. Please check it out!

title: 見晴らし抜群・夜も来てみたい
description: During my business trip to Yokkaichi, I was taken to the Port Building. The weather was nice, so the view was excellent. The night view, which attracts factory enthusiasts, must be beautiful as well. I want to go there.

title: 臨港橋＠四日市コンビナート夜景クルーズ
description:
To cover the attractions of Mie, I recently went on the Yokkaichi Industrial Complex Night View Cruise. You can find the article here → http://www.kankomie.or.jp/mMidokoro/detail_77_0.html

Since it was a 'Yokkaichi Full Course Plan' that included city sightseeing, I visited various tourist spots. One of them is the 'Rinkō Bridge,' which is raised only when a ship passes. I was lucky to see it!

title: 伊勢・安土桃山文化村の安土城からの眺め
description: To cover the highlights of Mie, I recently visited Ise and Azuchi Momoyama Cultural Village. The view from Azuchi Castle, which was built based on historical research, was incredibly refreshing.

title: 英虞湾の夕景
description: I stayed at Aqua Villa Ise-Shima in Shima City! It's a beautiful hotel located in a quiet area of nature. You can see Ago Bay from the room and while taking a walk outside. The sunset was very beautiful.

title: 海の幸に大満足！
description: I went to 'Matsuya' in Toba's Toji Island, Momotori. Of course, there were Ise shrimp and abalone, as well as a lot of seafood. I was very satisfied with the huge volume.

title: 志摩ｽﾍﾟｲﾝ村のキャラクターミュージカルショーは感動です！
description: I watched the new entertainment at Shima Spain Village, the character musical show 'Don Quixote and Everyone's Big Clock - The Little Angel's Drop -' that debuted on February 10. It was a heartwarming and comical story that moved not only children but also adults. Please take a look.

title: おひなさま
description: I went to the Futami Doll Festival. I had heard about it, but I was overwhelmed by the number and impact!

title: 富士山見えるかな〜
description: When I went to Shima, I passed through the Pearl Road from Toba. The view from the observatory along the way was amazing! I was lucky, as it seems you can also see Mount Fuji.

title: カンゲキ
description: The fireworks in Tsu were more beautiful than I imagined.

title: 紅葉
description: I visited Rokukaen and Moroto Family Garden. The beauty of the autumn leaves and the chirping of the small birds were very impressive.

title: 文字通り「光の海」！
description: This year's illumination theme is 'Fuji and the Sea'. The sound of waves was also playing, creating a fantastical atmosphere that felt like being drawn in.

title: おいしいもの大集合
description: I visited Ise Jingu and was very satisfied eating and buying delicious food at Okage Yokocho. I'm also looking forward to the oysters!

title: よさこいソーランフェスティバルin朝熊
description: The Yosakoi Soran Festival was held at the summit of Ise-Shima Skyline, where 13 teams with a total of 280 dancers showcased their splendid performances on the autumn peak of Asakuma Mountain.

title: 必殺！手裏剣
description: I went to the Ninja Museum. The ninja show was amazing and fun. After the show, I tried throwing shurikens.

title: サンタのコチラファミリー☆
description: I went to Suzuka Circuit. The Kochira family was in Santa version☆ I felt 'Merry Christmas' and had a lot of fun. I took a picture with Kochira-chan and shook hands! It was very fluffy.

title: メナード青山　イルミネーション
description: This year's theme is the cherry blossom avenue! Even on cold winter nights, the illuminated cherry blossom avenue warms the heart!

title: 伊勢ヨイ夜ナ
description: On my way back from Toba, I visited Ise Shrine and saw Ise Yoi Yona at Oharai-machi and Okage-yokocho. The warm lights of the candles and lanterns were very beautiful. It became a wonderful memory.

title: 安乗ふぐ〜シーズン到来〜
description: I had Anori fugu at Fukujuso on Wataraka Island in Shima City. It's natural tiger pufferfish and it's the best.

title: 鈴鹿がイチバン
description: I went to the F1 Japanese Grand Prix. The weather was perfect for the final. Suzuka is the best! Kamui Kobayashi is amazing. I'm looking forward to what's next.

title: EXPASA御在所・モクモク手づくりファーム
description: I recently visited the newly opened EXPASA Gozaisho. There are various shops, and it was very crowded. It's my favorite Mokumoku Handmade Farm shop.

title: 熊野古道「ツヅラト峠」
description: I took the JR Kumano Kodo 'Iseji' and walked the Kumano Kodo 'Tsuzuratotoge'. The view from the observatory at the pass was spectacular. It is also introduced in 'Mie no Midokoro Eetoko', so please take a look.

title: すべり台
description: The view is great, and the feeling is also great.

title: ジャンボ
description: On a hot day, a pool like the sea is the best.

title: 石取祭
description: This is a short video, but in reality, this noise continues for two days, making it the 'loudest festival in Japan.' This level of excitement is just from one festival float, so what would happen if around 40 floats all sounded off at once...? By the way, this commotion lasted until around 4 a.m. the next morning.

title: 七夕
description: After visiting Ise Jingu, I went to Okage Yokocho. It was Tanabata, and I wrote my wishes on a tanzaku and hung it on a bamboo. I hope good things will happen.

title: 初花火
description: I saw fireworks at the Ise lobster festival finale. It was beautiful.

title: 2010ハーレーダビッドソンＢＢＱパーティー
description: On April 11th (Sunday), about 200 Harley motorcycles gathered at the Ise-Shima Skyline. Participants enjoyed a pleasant ride under the full bloom of cherry blossoms.

title: 三重県観光プロモーション｜観光三重
description: This is a promotional video for tourism in Mie Prefecture.

title: Sakitama Kofungun
description: 埼玉古墳群は、5世紀末から7世紀初めにかけて建設され、日本の特別史跡に指定されています。埼玉県行田市で見ることができます。

title: Saitama Rapid Line Tour
description: 小成切り

title: Saikyo Line Tour
description: 埼玉県立芸術劇場

title: Tobu Tojo Line Tour
description: 時の鐘

title: Konosu Surprising Doll Festival
description: 380年の歴史を持つ「人形作り」を体験し、鴻巣の「鴻巣びっくり雛祭り」を楽しんでください。約7メートルの高さを誇る日本一の人形のピラミッドを目の当たりにしながら、日本の文化をお楽しみください。

title: （Full ver.）Magical Journey Fukushima 01  - A New Leaf, A New Day -

description:
【🍁Japan Heritage・Water Heritage「Eigenji」⛩】
Eigenji, located in Higashiomi City, Shiga Prefecture, is the head temple of the Rinzai sect Eigenji school, boasting a history of over 650 years.

The temple grounds feature a main hall (hōjō) with a thatched roof made of reed, one of the largest in the country, and designated tangible cultural properties of the prefecture.

Surrounded by deep nature, the temple complex can be enjoyed in various seasonal forms, and the vibrant red autumn leaves that cover the grounds in fall attract many visitors from across the country, making it one of the renowned autumn leaf viewing spots in Kansai.

While certain areas are usually off-limits to the public, special tours with volunteer guides allow for exclusive visits. Enjoy the charm of Eigenji, where the autumn leaves beautifully contrast with the ancient temple, through our videos.

Each time, people have devised ways to advance the riverbank construction of the Tone River. The stone walls, ranging from 1 to 4 meters high, are a flood control technique passed down from the past, and that technology continues to protect people today.

While reminiscing about ancient times, she took a deep breath in nature, refreshing both her mind and body.

Let's embark on a 1-night, 2-day journey to Aki City, a place you will want to visit again and again.

The next stage for Shibuya is to become a diverse town that adults can also enjoy. Akiko Yada will explore the various aspects of present-day Shibuya.

She embarked on a journey to explore local specialties nurtured by the strict yet rich nature, including Shinmiyu tea, while experiencing the passion of the people who connect traditions.

description: The Ogaki Festival's float event has been passed down as a ceremonial event in the castle town of Ogaki, representing the Mino region. The coexistence of the floats bestowed by the Ogaki feudal lord and those of the townspeople is rare nationwide. Additionally, the karakuri puppets show a strong influence from the float events in the Chukyo region, and the performing arts on the floats reflect the influence of float events in the Kinki region, indicating the interaction of festival cultures from east and west. This festival is considered important for understanding the transmission and transformation of domestic float, hoko, and yatai events.

ウェブサイト: http://untouchedhokkaido.jp/ FACEBOOK: https://www.facebook.com/untouchedhokkaido/ Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/untouched_hokkaido/?hl=en

歴史的・地理的に、ユニークな場所である東北海道は、⽇本でありながら北⽶プレートに位置するため、その植⽣はとてもに珍しい種類で溢れている。この⼟地だからこそ出逢える希少な野⽣⽣物、そして多くの⽣き物が暮らす⽇本の国⽴公園はその⾃然と共⽣する地元の⼈々がずっと昔から守りぬいてきた『⾃然が⼿付かずで残る場所（Untouched Hokkaido）』。 東北海道、この地域は豊かな清流でつながっており、日本の特別天然記念物でもある、優雅で美しいタンチョウが住んでいる。北海道の先住民族であるアイヌの言葉で、タンチョウはサロルンカムイ（湿原に住む神）と呼ばれていた。水は生命を育みながら、魔法をかけられたようにさまざまなカタチに変化する。

description: The deity enshrined is Umashimaji no Mikoto, the founder of the ancient powerful family Mononobe. Umashimaji no Mikoto is a child of Nigihayahi no Mikoto, and it is said that during the eastern expedition of Emperor Jimmu, he defeated Nagasunehiko and later led the Mononobe clan to protect the imperial castle. It has a history of more than 1500 years since its foundation, and the main shrine is the second largest shrine after Izumo Taisha. The shrine crest 'Hioi Crane' is a sacred crest based on the fact that Umashimaji no Mikoto descended on a crane, and is said to be the only shrine crest in Japan.

A long time ago, Yatsukamizuomitsunu no Mikoto thought, 'Izumo Province is like a long strip of cloth; I made the country too small at first. So let's make it bigger.' After completing the land dragging four times at Kiduki's cape, Sada's country, Kurami's country, and Miho's cape, Yatsukamizuomitsunu no Mikoto was enshrined in Nagahama as the god of land dragging, the general guardian of Izumo Province, who had completed the creation of the land. Due to the story of the Kunibiki myth, Yatsukamizuomitsunu no Mikoto is widely worshiped as a great god who attracted the country, attracted people, and attracted happiness, and a god who attracted victory.

Tsuyama Manabi no Tetsudoukan consists of a space displaying vehicles, a turntable, and the driving wheels of steam locomotives, as well as a space where visitors can learn about the history of Okayama's railways and the mechanisms of railways through hands-on experiences. The former Tsuyama roundhouse, built in 1936, is a valuable facility that boasts the second largest scale in Japan. A diesel locomotive 'DE50-1' equipped with a powerful engine, of which only one was manufactured in Japan, is preserved here. If you visit with your family, children will be thrilled! The sound of the whistle at 12:00 and 15:00 on opening days is impressive! This is a must-visit spot for those interested in railways and locomotives!

A training facility equipped with an environment conducive to nature experiences and training.

Carillon House, a training accommodation facility, is located on Maejima Island in Ushimado (Setouchi City, Okayama Prefecture), which is renowned as Japan's Aegean Sea. The tranquil scenery of olive trees and the blue sea is breathtakingly beautiful. The core facility, Carillon House, consists of a lodging building that accommodates 250 people, a training building, and a large hall. The vast grounds are equipped with an observatory, multipurpose workshop, and Bizen pottery climbing kiln, providing an optimal environment for a variety of activities and programs such as learning, outdoor activities, marine sports, and cultural experiences. It serves as a lodging-type seminar house for corporate training and also plays a role as a support facility for local events.

Please take a look at the great nature of the island from the sky, the beauty of the Seto Inland Sea's many islands, and the entire facility located by the sea!

The view from 'Maejima Sunset Park' and the site of the stone quarry used for the reconstruction of Osaka Castle, known as 'Osaka Castle Construction Remains', is breathtaking! Let's explore the island by rental bicycle♪

description: Niigata City, Shinano River and Bandai Bridge, the evolving port city of Niigata. The Shinano River, originating from the distant Kobushin Mountain and flowing into the Sea of Japan via the Nagano Chikuma River, has nourished the lives of people in the Niigata Plain, known as the best rice-producing area in Japan. Here in Niigata City, the river's role ends at Bandai Bridge and soon transforms as it approaches the Niigata West Port, which is about to celebrate its 150th anniversary. Niigata City continues to evolve as a waterfront city.

description:
Niigata City Fukushima Wetland Morning Mist Traditional Fishing
Fukushima Wetland, located in the northern district of Niigata City, is a habitat for over 200 species of migratory birds, cherished not only by the citizens but also by many bird lovers. It is also known as the northern limit habitat for rare plants such as the giant water lily. The traditional fishing that has been practiced in Fukushima Wetland for a long time involves boats gliding over the lake surface in the early morning. The silhouettes of fishermen blending into the morning mist represent a scene of Niigata that should be preserved along with the rich natural environment of the wetland.

The length of the giant snake is 82.8 meters, inspired by the date of the Uetsu Flood, August 28. The sight of the massive snake writhing and coiling in front of the town hall is breathtaking.

Since there were also gold mines in Nagano and Yamanashi Prefectures, the road that connected Sado and Toi, where gold was transported, was named 'Golden KAIDO'.

Tokamachi City Kiyotsu Gorge A Hidden Paradise Drenched in Seven Colors

Located in Tokamachi City, Niigata Prefecture, it is one of Japan's three great gorges. During the autumn foliage season, many tourists visit to admire the beauty of the majestic green schist and columnar jointing. It was closed due to a rockfall accident in 1988, but now, thanks to the opening of the Kiyotsu Gorge Tunnel, it can be enjoyed safely and securely. It is also a tourist spot where you can enjoy both the breathtaking views and hot springs.

ここでしか味わえない冒険が、あなたを待っている。

★Experience Making Japanese Sweets with Wooden Molds

★Experience Making Japanese Sweets with Wooden Molds (Tamura Manseido / Nanto City Tourism Association)
In Jōhana, Nanto City, Toyama Prefecture, you can experience making Japanese sweets using precious wooden molds owned by the long-established confectionery shop Tamura Manseido, as well as experience the atmosphere of tea ceremony through part of the bon temae practice. Since the Kansei era, Tamura Manseido has been passed down through generations and has a wooden mold museum displaying about 300 wooden molds, where you can enjoy exquisite wooden molds that are almost like works of art, along with stories about Jōhana sweets from the shop owner. In Jōhana, a small Kyoto of Etchū, rich in cultural heritage and faith, why not immerse yourself in the aroma of the tea culture encouraged by the Kaga Maeda clan?

title: 小田原漆器の椀 - 日常使いできる「本物」 2017/07/07 Fri.
description: Odawara lacquerware uses durable and less warped keyaki wood for its base. By repeatedly applying natural lacquer, which also acts as a protector, the bowls become even stronger and more beautiful in grain. While lacquerware may seem difficult to handle, Odawara lacquerware bowls are sturdy, practical, and truly 'authentic' for everyday use. The Odawara-Hakone region has been a woodworking area that has developed for over a thousand years, primarily focusing on lathe turning. The beginning of Odawara lacquerware dates back to the Muromachi period when lacquer was applied to turned wooden bowls. Since then, it has developed as practical lacquerware. The main video introduces the wood turning and lacquer application by craftsmen from Odawara.

title: GREENable HIRUZEN
description: いつからか人々の生活が自然の営みから距離を置いたことで人と自然の均衡が崩れつつある中、人と自然が共に育む生態系が蒜山にはまだ残っている。そこは、人と自然が不可分に溶け合い、『蒜山時間』とも言われる、自然の流れに合わせゆったりとした時間が流れる空間。人と自然が互いに活かし生きるために、自然を守り、豊かに育てる。GREENableは、人と自然が共に生きられる関係性を回復する活動でありブランド。私たちが本当に持っていた豊かさをここ蒜山で感じてみませんか。

title: 瀬見温泉
description: A quiet hot spring area overlooking the clear stream of the Mogami Oguni River. Blessed with scenic mountain waters, this hot spring area is particularly wonderful during the autumn foliage season. It is said that this hot spring began when Benkei, searching for a birthing bath for his wife, the North Lady, who gave birth to Kamewakamaru, found the rising steam from a nearby rock. Nearby, there are many legends and historical sites related to Yoshitsune and Benkei, such as the Kamewari Koyasu Kannon, which was said to have blessed the birth of Kamewakamaru, and the Yumoto Shrine, where the guardian deity of Semmi Onsen is enshrined. In summer, many people can be seen enjoying sweetfish fishing in the nearby Mogami Oguni River.

title: 山刀伐峠
description: Yamato-bari Pass is one of the passes connecting Mogami Town and Obanazawa City. Although its elevation is only 470 meters, the northern side towards Mogami Town is steep, while the southern side towards Obanazawa City has a relatively gentle terrain. On May 17, 1689, in the Genroku era, Matsuo Basho and Kawai Sora stayed at the house of a feudal lord in Mogami Town and then crossed the Yamato-bari Pass, which is said to be the 'greatest difficulty' in 'The Narrow Road to the Deep North', heading towards Obanazawa City. It is now maintained as a walking path and remains a valuable historic site that recalls Matsuo Basho's journey even after 300 years.

title: 堺田分水嶺
description: Sakaida Station on the Rikuyu East Line has a watershed where water divides into the Pacific Ocean and the Japan Sea. While typical watersheds are formed in high terrains such as mountains and hills, it is rare to find one in a flat area, allowing you to see the flow.

description: At Satonoba University, students study abroad in various regions for four years, exploring their interests through encounters and dialogues with various people in the community, and connecting these experiences to their own projects. We offer courses for university students and working adults, with options for study abroad within one year or not.

title: The SUKIYAKI Gastronomy Cycling Tour
description:
■アクティビティの詳細■
水路や古民家、美しい里山の風景が広がる丹生は、日本の独特な風景を楽しむサイクリングアドベンチャーにぴったりの場所です。地元の人々は、かつて人々が痩せた土地に水路を掘り、豊かな農業コミュニティを作った日々を誇りに思い、今でも語り継いでいます。このプログラムでは、参加者が村の四季折々の風景の中をサイクリングし、その歴史を体験する機会を提供します。サイクリングの後は、特産松阪牛を使ったすきやきを楽しみます。松阪牛はすでに世界的に有名ですが、この品種は松阪牛全体のわずか4%しか存在せず、特に特別なごちそうです。美しい村々を巡る贅沢なサイクリングツアーの後、最高級の和牛を味わえます。
オプションでオーガニック農園での野菜収穫体験も可能です。

description: ＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊【旅行のための特別なアクティビティ情報】ビデオに紹介されているスポットやプログラムについて詳しく学ぶ・英語（English）https://www.kankomie.or.jp/special/fortravelagencies/en/・日本語（Japanese）https://www.kankomie.or.jp/special/fortravelagencies/【三重県観光公式サイト】三重について詳しく学ぶ・英語（English）https://www.kankomie.or.jp/en/・繁体字（Traditional Chinese）https://www.kankomie.or.jp/tw/・簡体字（Simplified characters）https://www.kankomie.or.jp/cn/・タイ語（Thai）https://www.kankomie.or.jp/th/・韓国語（Korean）https://www.kankomie.or.jp/ko/・日本語（Japanese）https://www.kankomie.or.jp【三重県観光公式SNS】＜英語（English）＞・Facebook / @travelmiejapan ・Instagram / @visitmie ・YouTube / @japantravelmie4723＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊＊

title: Premium dinner with Ama butler at private beach
description:
■アクティビティの詳細■
海女は、あわびやウニなどの海鮮を捕る女性の素潜り漁師です。海女漁は、三重県志摩市で2000年以上の伝統があり、重要無形民俗文化財に指定されています。200名以上の現役海女がいるこの地域は、国内でも数少ない海女漁が行われている場所です。海女の平均年齢は65歳です！

このプログラムでは、参加者がエネルギッシュな海女と共に志摩を満喫する機会を提供します。まず、参加者は海女と共に船で出かけ、伝統的なかご漁法を体験し、新鮮な海鮮を収穫します。次に、捕れたばかりの海鮮を使った特別ディナーをプライベートビーチで楽しみます。海女が専属のバトラーとして、忘れられない体験を提供します。

title: Nagatanien, the Iga ware kiln with 200 years of Japanese culinary history
description: ■活動内容■三重県北部の穏やかな里山に煙突が立ち並ぶ伊賀焼の里、丸柱に位置しています。この地で作られる陶器は耐火性が高く、古くから直火用の土鍋や土瓶が作られてきました。長谷園は1832年に創業し、伊賀焼の技術を継承し続けており、日本国内外で高く評価されています。このプログラムでは、8代目当主による特別な登り窯見学と伊賀焼に関する秘話を聞くことができ、長谷園の土鍋を使った炊飯体験もできます。ぜひこの独特な陶器で炊いた美味しいご飯を味わってみてください！

title: Walk the Magose pass on the Kumano Kodo trail, UNESCO World heritage site
description:
■アクティビティの詳細■
かつて、日本全国から人々が伊勢神宮や熊野三山などの聖地を巡るために何百キロも歩くことが流行しました。多くの旅人が熊野三山へ向かうために通った険しい馬越峠は、「紀伊山地の霊場と参詣道」の一部です。森の奥へと続く美しい石畳は、地元の人々によって何世代にもわたり大切に保全され、今も昔の姿を留めています。このプログラムでは、浮世絵や歴史的文献を参考に再現された旅装束を身にまとい、かつての旅人たちのように馬越峠を歩くことができます。プログラムの一部の収益は、石畳の保全活動に使われ、未来の世代のために美しい景色を守ります。

title: A unique pearl jewelry experience at Pearl Miki Discover and learn pearl culture in Iseshima
description: ■アクティビティの詳細■ 三重県志摩市は真珠養殖の発祥の地です。豊かな海の資源と伝統的な技術のおかげで、志摩の真珠は世界でも最高品質のものとして知られています。このプログラムでは、参加者が真珠養殖場を訪れ、職人と話しながら養殖技術を直接学ぶ機会があります。また、貝から真珠を取り出す体験や、非常に珍しい母貝への核入れ作業を体験し、真珠養殖の難しさを実感することができます。最後に、参加者は取り出した真珠を使って、世界に一つだけのオリジナルジュエリーを作成します。

title: An authentic Ninja experience on the site of a mountain castle
description:
■アクティビティの詳細■
かつて伊賀には山城が多く築かれ、山岳地帯での戦において山を素早く移動できる忍者は重宝されました。本プログラムは、かつての忍者のように山城を使って忍術を学ぶ、本格的な忍者体験です。初回は「入門編」として、道場（屋内）で伊賀発祥の忍術をベースとした呼吸法や印、歩き方の基礎を学びます。昼食後、実際に忍者が活動した記録の残る山城を散策しながら、山城ならではの森での刀の振り方、鍵縄の使い方、隠れ方等々に挑戦。本プログラムは、日本忍者協議会の忍道プログラムを用いており、体系的なカリキュラムに基づいた継続的なステップアップもできる国内でも珍しいワークショップです。

description: Earthboat へとつながる「道程」をエンターテイメントに変え、その土地らしさを楽しむ「方法」を提案する体験プラン。それが『Earthboat Way』。ラグジュアリータクシーを貸し切って「道のり」そのものを楽しみながら目的地へ。都会から大自然の景色へと移り行く先にあるのはキャンプより快適で、ホテルより自然を感じられるサウナ付きトレーラーハウスEarthboat。

This tour offers a special opportunity to see the behind-the-scenes operations of this large ropeway, which includes many extraordinary devices that are not usually accessible. After the tour, you can also enjoy the breathtaking view from SORA terrace at an altitude of 1,770m.

title: 玉の浦ビーチ（玉の浦海水浴場）
description: Tama no Ura Beach (seaside resort) is a quiet beach with a gently sloping sandy shore, making it a family-friendly spot. It is open as a swimming beach in the summer. Additionally, there is the shortest river in Japan, 'Butsubutsu River,' nearby.

title: （那智勝浦町・観光スポット）補陀洛山寺
description: Bodairokusan Temple is located just across the national road from JR Nachi Station. It enshrines the sea-crossing monks. The Hamano-Miya Coast, which spreads out in front of Nachi Station, is where the sea-crossing monks set out for the Bodairokudo, sitting in their boats, believed to be heading towards the Pure Land of Kannon, which was thought to be at the end of the southern seas for about a thousand years since the Heian period. We hope you will visit!

description: This is a digest video of the fireworks festival held on August 18, 2024 (Sunday).

title: Japan's Strange Fire Festival - Takizanji Ogre Festival
description: 日本には不思議な祭りが数多く存在するが、中でもこの鬼祭りは寺で火を焚くという異質そのもの。「なぜ燃えないのか」そんな疑問を抱く間もなく火の勢いに圧倒された。

title: 京都市観光PR映像本編_KYOTO PROMOTIONAL MOVIE -Where Every Corner Sparks Discovery-
description: For more details about this video, please visit our website.

title: とっておきの京都プロジェクト 山科
description: Yamashina, which boasts the Lake Biwa Canal, an industrial heritage from the Meiji era, is introduced through its ancient temples known as 'kosatsu', cherry blossom spots, famous locations where you can enjoy the autumn foliage light-up, and Kiyomizu-yaki, one of Kyoto's representative traditional crafts.

title: とっておきの京都プロジェクト 伏見
description: Fushimi, known as 'Fushimizu' for its high-quality underground water, is introduced through sake breweries and famous water that produce some of Japan's finest sake, as well as the shopping streets that were once a castle town.

title: とっておきの京都プロジェクト 京北
description: Kyohoku, which has long been a royal estate associated with the imperial family, is introduced through activities that allow you to enjoy temples, shrines, and rich nature, as well as farm stays where you can experience rural life.

title: Hidden Gems of Kyoto  FUSHIMI
description: 「伏水」と称されるほど，良質な地下水が湧き出る伏見を，日本有数の酒どころとしている酒蔵や名水により醸される日本酒，かつて城下町であった商店街などを通して紹介。

title: Hidden Gems of Kyoto  Keihoku
description: 古くから皇室ゆかりの御料地であった京北を，寺院や神社，豊かな自然を満喫できるアクティビティ，田舎暮らしを体験できる農家民宿を通して紹介。

title: Hidden Gems of Kyoto  Takao
description: Takao, where the清滝川 flows, is a temple built in the '三尾' formed by three peaks (高雄・槇尾・栂尾), showcasing beautiful blue leaves and autumn foliage, as well as the cool riverbed cuisine of summer in Kyoto.

title: Hidden Gems of Kyoto  Yamashina
description: This text is already in Japanese.

title: Hidden Gems of Kyoto  Nishikyo
description: 桂・松尾・洛西・大原野の４エリアを，四季を通して楽しめる「花名所」の寺院や神社，静寂に包まれた竹林，疲れを癒す天然温泉を通して紹介。

title: Hidden Gems of Kyoto  Ohara
description: A quiet rural area spreads in Ohara, introducing temples that convey the culture of 'Shomyo' (chanting of sutras with a unique melody) and their famous gardens, red shiso fields at the foot of the mountains, and shops where you can taste fresh vegetables produced in Ohara.

title: 京都一周トレイル　ダイジェスト
description: This is a digest video introducing the 'Kyoto Loop Trail', which consists of four courses (Higashiyama, Kitayama East, Kitayama West, and Nishiyama) with a total length of about 83.3 kilometers, starting from Fushimi Momoyama in the southeast of Kyoto, passing through Mount Hiei, Ohara, Kurama, Takao, Arashiyama, and Kokedera, as well as one course in the Kyoto North region with a total length of about 48.7 kilometers, blessed with rich forests, clear streams, and rural landscapes. It introduces Kyoto's nature, historical and cultural heritage including World Heritage sites, and gourmet information.

title: 【京都一周トレイル®公式】京北コース
description: The Kyoto Loop Trail® 'Keihoku Course' is a course of approximately 48.7 km that circles the nature-rich Keihoku area, about an hour by bus from Kyoto Station. The entire area is included in the Tanba Highlands, with over 90% being forested. It is a region blessed with greenery and cool even in summer. You can enjoy many scenic spots such as the Takimata Falls, the Jojoin Temple famous for its cherry blossoms, and the suspension bridge at Uo-ga-buchi, as well as breathtaking views of the satoyama landscape. (This course is slightly more advanced than others.)

title: 【京都一周トレイル®公式】西山コース
description: The Nishiyama Course of the Kyoto Loop Trail® is a course where you can feel the richness of Kyoto's tradition and greenery. While enjoying the natural beauty of Arashiyama, you can also visit famous temples and shrines such as Saiho-ji (Moss Temple) and Tenryu-ji. The small path along the clear stream of Kiyotaki River is also recommended for families.

title: 【京都一周トレイル®公式】東山コース
description: The Higashiyama Course of the Kyoto Loop Trail® is a route of approximately 9.5 km that takes you around the Fushimi Momoyama and Fukakusa areas, and a hiking course of about 24.6 km that goes from Fushimi Inari Taisha to Kiyomizu-yama, Incline, Daimonji-yama Yotsujiji, and the Philosopher's Path to Mount Hiei. You can enjoy a view of Kyoto's urban area and experience rich nature, history, and culture. The course is easily accessible and recommended for beginners.

title: 【京都一周トレイル®公式】北山西部コース
description: The Kyoto Loop Trail® 'Kitayama West Course' is a hiking course where you can enjoy the vibrant nature of cherry blossoms, fresh greenery, autumn leaves, and snowy landscapes through the straight rows of Kitayama cedar trees. You can encounter the rich history and culture of Kyoto, a place cherished since ancient times. Pay attention to the historical place names like Himuro and Kyomidaira, which evoke a sense of the past.

title: 【京都一周トレイル®公式】北山東部コース
description: The Kyoto Loop Trail® 'Kitayama East Course' is a hiking course of approximately 17.9 km that crosses the majestic Mount Hiei, passing through the tranquil landscapes of Ohara and Shizuhara, and reaching Ninose. You can enjoy a view of Kyoto's urban area and experience rich nature, history, and culture.

title: 京都自転車観光ガイド（奥嵯峨編）
description: Kyoto's top tourist destination, Arashiyama. In the depths lies the Oku-Saga area, which is quietly imbued with charm, and we will explore it by electric bicycle.

title: 京都自転車観光ガイド（哲学の道・岡崎編）
description: Kyoto's center of art and culture, the Okazaki area, and the famous spots along the Philosopher's Path, which extends along the canal, will be explored by a nimble bicycle.

title: 京都自転車観光ガイド（京北編）
description: Located in the northwestern part of Kyoto City, we will explore Keihoku in the Ukyo Ward by sports bike. The charm of cycling is experiencing the great nature of Kyoto firsthand. One of the pleasures is tasting the 'delicacies' filled with the blessings of the land.

title: 京都自転車観光ガイド（西京編）
description: Kyoto's Nishikyo area, located at the western edge of Kyoto City. In particular, we will cycle quickly through the cycling road from Arashiyama to Matsuo and Katsura, faster than using trains or buses.

title: 京都自転車観光ガイド（伏見編）
description: Originally written as 'Fushimizu'. We will leisurely explore Fushimi, known for its high-quality and abundant water, the culture of sake brewing that arose from it, and the remnants of its once-thriving water transport.

title: 京都自転車観光ガイド（北山編）
description: The Kitayama area offers beautiful nature along with the traditional atmosphere of Kyoto. Explore popular spots supported by locals conveniently by bicycle.

title: 京都自転車観光ガイド西山編）
description: Bamboo paths and the rural landscape of Ohara, enjoy the close proximity of town and nature, and encounter the original scenery of Japan in the Nishiyama area through cycling!

title: 京都自転車観光ガイド　ダイジェスト版
description: This is a digest version of a video introducing various areas in Kyoto City (Okusaga, Nishikyo, Kitayama, around Kyoto Station, Okazaki, Fushimi, Kyoko, Nishiyama) that can be explored by bicycle. It introduces historical and cultural sites, as well as gourmet information, including World Heritage sites.

title: KYOTO SERENDIPITY - Charlotte Perriand
description: 「空間にリズムを与える、自由な形」。モダニズムの巨匠シャルロット・ペリアン。彼女の代表作である『Nuage a Plots bookshelf』は、実は京都の桂離宮にある「違い棚」から着想を得て生まれたと言われています。桂離宮の機能美、そして河井寛次郎らとの出会いによる民藝哲学への共感。20世紀のデザイン史に影響を与えた、「出会い」の物語に触れよう。

title: KYOTO SERENDIPITY - John Cage
description: 「静寂とは、音がないことではなく、心の扉を開くこと」。 音楽家・ジョン・ケージは、龍安寺の石庭に深いインスピレーションを受けました。彼は石庭を眺めるだけではなく、石の輪郭をなぞることで音を紡ぎ、偶然性と虚無の中に音楽を見出したのです。彼にとって、京都の美意識は音楽そのものでした。 日常の喧騒を離れ、心研ぎ澄ます静寂の旅へ。

title: KYOTO SERENDIPITY - Isabella Bird
description: 「ガイドブックのその先にある、真の京都」。 明治期、1878年に京都を訪れた英国人探検家イザベラ・バード。彼女がこの地で見つけたのは、単なる風景ではなく、人々の暮らしに根付く「清潔さ」「自尊心」、そして「相互扶助」の精神でした。「日本の人々はまじめで勤勉で礼儀正しい」。 彼女が感動した普遍的な美徳と、受け継がれる暮らしの美に触れる旅へ。

title: 【夏の富山の絶景】開通した称名滝に行ったら、幻の滝とのV字光景が見れた！
description:
【Latest Information】Updated on June 6, 2022
★The walking path (approximately 1.3 km) from the parking lot to the waterfall has reopened since May 21, 2022 (Saturday). For the time being, the passage hours are from 8:00 to 17:00.★

Shomyo Falls is one of Toyama Prefecture's top hidden spots, boasting a drop of 350 meters, making it the tallest waterfall in Japan. It is also designated as a national scenic spot and natural monument, and is selected as one of Japan's top 100 waterfalls.

From April to May, the melting snow from the Tateyama mountain range flows into the valley with remaining snow, revealing the "Hannoki Falls" on the right side of Shomyo Falls. The two waterfalls cascade down, creating a magnificent V-shaped scenery.

It takes about one hour by car from Toyama city to the parking lot of Shomyo Falls. Then, it takes about 30 minutes on foot from the parking lot to the waterfall, totaling approximately 1 hour and 30 minutes.

*Since it takes about 30 minutes to walk from the parking lot to the waterfall spot, comfortable shoes are recommended. Also, as there is water spray at the bottom of the waterfall, it is advisable to bring a raincoat.

【Shomyo Falls Accessible Period】
Typically from early May to late November, depending on snow conditions.
【Fee】
Free
【Parking】
247 cars (free)
【Access】
- About 60 minutes by car from Toyama city center + 30 minutes on foot
- About 50 minutes by car from the Hokuriku Expressway Tateyama IC + 30 minutes on foot
- About 15 minutes by bus from Toyama Chihō Railway Tateyama Station to Shomyo Falls + 30 minutes on foot

title: 織田公公園（群馬県甘楽町）
description:
Location: 1416 Obata, Kanra Town
Kanra Town designated historic site: June 20, 1963

There are graves of seven generations from Oda Nobuhiro, the lord of Obata, to Nobutomi at Suifukuji Temple. In the first year of Genna (1615), Nobuhiro (the second son of Oda Nobunaga) became the lord of 50,000 koku in Yamato Matsuyama (Uda City, Nara Prefecture) and Ueno (Obata, Gunma Prefecture), and his son Nobuyoshi entered the domain, starting the Oda clan's governance in Obata. The third generation, Nobumasa, followed the last wishes of his grandfather Nobuhiro and ceded 30,000 koku of Matsuyama to his uncle Oda Takanaga, leaving only 20,000 koku in Obata. After that, until the incident in the fourth year of Meiwa (1767), they governed the Obata domain for 152 years across eight generations. The gravestones of the Oda clan are all five-ring pagodas, lined up in order from the first generation Nobuhiro to Nobuyoshi, Nobumasa, Nobuhisa, Nobushige, Nobutaka, and Nobutomi, showing the dignity of a feudal lord's burial site. Initially, the Oda clan used Hōshakuji Temple in Todoroki as their family temple, but during the time of the fourth generation Nobuhisa, they moved to Suifukuji Temple. Suifukuji Temple suffered fires in the eighth year of Hōreki (1758) and the fourth year of Meiji (1871), damaging the gravestones of the fifth generation and below.

description:
【Shooting date: 2015.6.30】
Amabiki Kannon is known as a deity with miraculous powers for safe childbirth, child-rearing, child-giving, warding off evil, and financial fortune. It is also loved as a tourist spot with its majestic architecture, historical cultural assets, beautiful peacocks roaming freely in the precincts, and hydrangeas that color the grounds.

title: 【絶景茨城】牛久大仏 ［4K］茨城県牛久市｜VISIT IBARAKI,JAPAN
description: Ushiku Great Buddha is a project led by the Higashi Honganji sect of Jodo Shinshu. The founder of Jodo Shinshu is Shinran Shonin (1173-1262). Shinran was exiled to Echigo Province in 1207 due to the anger of Emperor Go-Toba. After being pardoned four years later, he entered Hitachi Province (now Ibaraki Prefecture) and established a base for propagation in the Kanto region. Many temples and historical sites related to Shinran remain in the prefecture, and Ushiku is one of them. The project began in 1983, construction started in 1986, and it was completed in December 1992. The project is led by the Higashi Honganji sect of Jodo Shinshu. Its form is an enlarged version of the Amida Nyorai statue, which is the main object of worship of this sect. It boasts a total height of 120m (100m for the statue and 20m for the pedestal), nearly three times the height of the Great Buddha of Nara (14.98m) and the effective height of the Statue of Liberty in New York, USA (93m total height, 46.05m for the statue in a raised hand position, and 33.86m from feet to top of the head).

title: 【絶景茨城】百段階段ひなまつり-茨城県久慈郡大子町｜VISIT IBARAKI,JAPAN
description: The 'Hina Matsuri on the Hundred Steps' is held every year on the approach to the Juuniso Shrine in Daigo Town, Ibaraki Prefecture. The hina dolls provided from all over the country are filled with various histories, and each one is full of individuality. In the retro townscape that remains, tiered displays and hina decorations are lined up in front of various shops and houses in the shopping district. On the same day, a bridal procession takes place on the street in front of the station, where newlyweds walk through the town.

title: 【絶景茨城】山桜｜VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description: In Sakura City, Ibaraki Prefecture, approximately 550,000 mountain cherry trees grow naturally, creating a patchwork landscape of pale pink cherry blossoms and fresh green trees. Around Isobe Sakuragawa Park, you can see about 550 cherry trees. The area including Sakuragawa Isobe Inamura Shrine and the park is designated as a national scenic spot, and the cherry trees in the shrine and park are designated as national natural monuments.

title: 【2025年最新版】空撮で魅せるネモフィラ＆チューリップ｜茨城・国営ひたち海浜公園【絶景茨城】
description: The breathtaking scenery of nemophila at Hitachi Seaside Park, which is attracting attention both domestically and internationally. Enjoy the fantastic landscape of 270,000 tulips that can be enjoyed at the same time.

title: 【絶景茨城】ハス田｜VISIT IBARAKI,JAPAN
description:
In Ibaraki Prefecture, which boasts the highest production of lotus root in Japan, lotus flowers can be seen blooming around Kasumigaura from July to August. The lotus flowers blooming beside the vast lake captivate people along with the sunlight shining on the lake's surface.

In autumn, the leaves turn brown and begin to wither. During the harvesting of lotus root, a method called 'water digging' is employed to bring the lotus root to the surface. Care is taken to wash off the mud gently after digging it up to avoid damaging the skin of the lotus root. Its plump, dumpling-like shape and soft texture, along with a hint of sweetness, are its charms.

Thanks to the abundant water resources and fertile soil of Kasumigaura, delicious lotus roots loved throughout Japan are cultivated.

title: 【絶景茨城】日立市かみね動物園｜VISIT IBARAKI,JAPAN
description: Located in a prime location overlooking the Pacific Ocean, Hitachi City Kamine Zoo has been loved for many years. We hope you feel warm seeing the cute animals such as elephants, squirrel monkeys, red pandas, giraffes, penguins, otters, and iguanas.

title: 【絶景茨城】竜神峡・竜神大吊橋 ［4K］茨城県常陸太田市｜VISIT IBARAKI,JAPAN
description: The 'Ryujin Big Suspension Bridge' is an iron bridge spanning the Ryujin Gorge, which is listed as one of the Ibaraki Hundred Scenic Views. The bridge is 375 meters long and 100 meters high from the surface of the dam lake. From the bridge, you can enjoy breathtaking views throughout the four seasons.

title: 【絶景茨城／日本遺産】弘道館［4K］茨城県水戸市｜VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description:
【Shooting date: 2015.5.27】
Kodokan, a nationally designated special historic site and important cultural property located in Mito City, Ibaraki Prefecture. Established in 1842 by the 9th lord of the Mito domain, Tokugawa Nariaki, it is the largest domain school in Japan. The last shogun, Tokugawa Yoshinobu, also studied here during his childhood and spent his life in confinement after the restoration of imperial rule. This time, we were able to capture footage of parts that are usually not seen, such as the actual 'bird's-eye view' (choukanzu), the interior of the Confucius Temple, and the Kodokan monument housed in the Hakkeido.

title: 【絶景茨城】紅葉［4K］｜VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description:
【Shooting date 2015.11.17】
Ibaraki Prefecture's representative autumn foliage spots, Hanakuni Valley (Takahagi City), Ryujin Big Suspension Bridge (Hitachiota City), Eigenji and Fukuroda Falls (Daigo Town), and Hanazono Valley (Kitaibaraki City) are captured in stunning autumn scenery. Enjoy the vibrant reds and yellows that color Ibaraki's autumn.

title: 【絶景茨城】大杉神社 大杉祭（あんばまち）　茨城県稲敷市｜VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description:
【Shooting date 2015.10.25】
Far back in history, Oosugi Shrine has been revered as 'Anba-sama' and is still known for its miracles and traditions, recognized as Japan's only 'Yume Musubi Daimyojin'. Please take a look at the lively procession and the traditional performing art 'Anba Bayashi' that the local people cherish during the autumn festival, Oosugi Festival, also known as 'Anbamachi'.

description: The Hitachi Kuni Sosha Shrine Grand Festival, also known as the 'Ishioka Festival', is counted among the three major festivals of the Kanto region. It features a large lion head that has become a symbol of Ishioka City. The festival includes the prefecturally designated intangible folk cultural assets 'Sasara' and 'Ishioka Bayashi'. Enjoy the grandeur of this magnificent festival, which attracts hundreds of thousands of tourists from across the country.

title: 【絶景茨城】潮来祇園祭禮｜VISIT IBARAKI, JAPAN
description: The Itako Gion Festival, with a history and tradition of over 800 years, is held in early August (for three days) every year. The 14 donated floats, which convey the craftsmanship of the Edo and Meiji periods, are carefully managed as treasures of each town. The sight of the young men, floats, and performing arts group coming together in a display called 'Kurubiki' is breathtaking.

Lake Hiraka, a rare brackish lake where seawater and freshwater mix, is located almost in the center of Ibaraki Prefecture, spanning Ibaraki Town, Hokota City, and Oarai Town. Its watershed is a valuable ecosystem that is home to many plants and animals, and its bounty supports the local fishing industry.

During the 'Kasama Azalea Festival,' events such as outdoor tea ceremonies and traditional music performances are held, attracting many tourists.

"Kamune Park" in Hitachi City, Ibaraki Prefecture, and "Heiwa Street" in front of Hitachi Station have been selected as one of Japan's top 100 cherry blossom spots. The wind that runs between the sea and the mountains sways the beautiful cherry blossoms, coloring the lives of the people living in the city and attracting tourists from inside and outside Ibaraki Prefecture, making the city lively. Every spring, the Hitachi Cherry Blossom Festival is held, and the float "Hitachi Furyumono," registered as a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage, adds a powerful presence to the cherry blossom scenery.

Fukuoka Weir is also famous as a cherry blossom spot, and every year the 'Fukuoka Weir Cherry Blossom Festival' is held. It has been selected as one of the 100 best tourist attractions in Ibaraki, and you can see a tunnel of cherry blossoms with about 600 trees blooming along a 1.8 km promenade.

title: 【高画質】阿蘇山観音まつり
description:
On April 13, 2023, the 'Aso Mountain Kannon Festival' was held at the Saigandaji Temple in Kurokawa, Aso City, where many worshippers gathered to participate in the ascetic practices 'fire walking' and 'yudate' performed by practitioners in Yamabushi attire.

When the fire was lit on the goma altar made of cypress leaves, the practitioners solemnly chanted sutras and threw goma wood with written wishes into the fire to pray for good health. Then, the 'fire walking' was conducted, where participants walked barefoot over the burning flames.

After the fire's intensity diminished, general worshippers followed the practitioners and walked barefoot over the ashes, and finally participated in the ascetic practice 'yudate,' where they were splashed with boiling hot water to pray for a year of good health.

This Aso Mountain Kannon Festival is held annually on April 13, the anniversary of the death of the temple's priest, Churi Ryoshun, who died in the Seinan War.

description: A series capturing the rich landscapes of Aso with a 4K camera, 'SCENE of the ASO'. Volume 6 features the spring tradition of Aso, 'wildfire'. The grasslands of Aso not only serve as pasture for cattle and horses and winter feed but also absorb large amounts of rain, becoming the source of six first-class rivers and the water reservoir of Kyushu. Additionally, rare flora and fauna unique to the grasslands thrive and inhabit the area, and the wildfires have maintained these grasslands for over a thousand years. This time, we will focus on the 'wildfire experience event' organized by 'Aso Tan Guide Tours', where participants can experience the ignition of the wildfire held in the ancient pasture of Aso City, Kochi. The long-take footage can be enjoyed even more by watching it at double speed.

description: A series capturing the rich natural scenery of Aso with a 4K camera, titled 'SCENE of the ASO'. Volume 1 features the 'Tenno Waterwheel' located at the foot of the Aso outer rim. This area is known for its famous spring water, with clear streams flowing behind the waterwheel. Additionally, a local revitalization group called 'Tenno Meisui Kai' is involved in the environmental maintenance of the waterwheel and famous water spots.

title: 【大自然4K】「阿蘇 中岳火口」高画質 癒し映像
description: A series of 4K camera recordings of the rich natural scenery of Aso, titled 'SCENE of the ASO'. Volume 2 features the 'Nakadake Crater', where you can feel the powerful heartbeat of the earth. The people of Aso have lived alongside the Aso volcano for over a thousand years. The volcanic activity of Nakadake provides us with blessings such as vast grasslands, hot springs, and underground water, while also teaching us the wonders of nature. Although the Nakadake, which erupted on October 20, 2021, is currently under eruption alert level 3 with entry restrictions, please enjoy the footage taken from the summit of Nakadake at an altitude of 1,506 meters, the Higashiho Observatory, and the crater rim of Nakadake No. 1 in August and September 2021.

title: 【大自然4K】「阿蘇 雲海」高画質 癒し映像
description: A series capturing the rich natural scenery of Aso with a 4K camera, 'SCENE of the ASO'. Volume 3 features the fantastic landscape of the sea of clouds in Aso. From autumn to winter, the Aso valley welcomes the season of sea of clouds. When high humidity, radiative cooling, and calm winds coincide, it occurs from just before dawn to early morning. Filmed in November 2021 at the popular spot 'Sorafune no Sanbashi' in Aso City, Tagoyama. Watching at double speed enhances the enjoyment of the flowing clouds.

title: 【大自然4K】「阿蘇 しめ縄作り」高画質 癒し映像
description: A series capturing the rich natural scenery of Aso with a 4K camera, 'SCENE of the ASO'. Volume 4 features the traditional Aso shrine shime nawa making, a year-end custom in Aso. The large shime nawa displayed at Aso Shrine is made by the 'Ichinomiya Town Shimenawa Heritage Association' from local residents, a tradition that has been ongoing for over 30 years. This year, preparations began in October, and a 7.5-meter long, 150-kilogram shime nawa was completed by 17 members. It was dedicated to Aso Shrine on December 8, 2021, and beautifully adorns the newly rebuilt hall, which just completed restoration work from the Kumamoto earthquake in June. As we welcome the first New Year at the rebuilt hall, we invite you to visit Aso Shrine for your first shrine visit of the year.

title: 【大自然4K】「阿蘇 冬景色」高画質 癒し映像
description: A series capturing the rich natural scenery of Aso with a 4K camera, titled 'SCENE of the ASO'. Volume 5 features the beautiful winter scenery of Aso, which shows its stunning appearance even in the harsh cold. In Aso, which is located in Kyushu but has a high altitude, various ice arts are born in winter. Enjoy the 'three great ice of Aso': 'Juhyo', 'Koga Falls Icefall', and 'Sensuikyo Ice Pillars'.

title: 【大自然4K】「阿蘇 阿蘇高菜」高画質 癒し映像
description: A series of 4K camera captures of the rich natural scenery of Aso. Volume 7 features the spring delicacy 'Aso Takana'. Aso Takana is a variety of mustard plant from the Brassicaceae family, grown in Aso's unique nature with significant temperature differences and volcanic ash-rich soil. Seeds are sown in October, overwinter under snow, and harvested in March to April. The harvesting method, where each stem is bent by hand, is called 'Takana-ori'. On beautiful spring days, scenes of Takana-ori in the Takana fields are common in the Aso region. After harvesting, it is immediately pickled. By kneading salt and chili peppers, the new pickles can be enjoyed with a sharp spiciness and crunchy texture after about a week. Enjoy the sounds of the Takana-ori and the kneading process.

title: いわて短角牛の郷－夏山の風景－
description:
Iwate Shorthorn Cattle is... Domestic beef cattle that account for only about 0.4% of the beef distributed in Japan, the elusive wagyu 'Japanese Shorthorn'. Iwate Prefecture is said to be the birthplace of the Japanese Shorthorn and is also the largest production area in the country.

From spring to autumn, they live together in the grazing area under the 'Summer Mountain Winter Village' method. They spend about six months with their mother in the grazing area after birth, and then they are raised in a barn as beef cattle, eventually providing delicious meat to everyone.

Please enjoy the scenery of the summer mountains nurtured by the majestic nature.

title: いわて短角牛の郷－平庭闘牛－
description:
Iwate Short-Horned Cattle is... A rare Japanese beef known as 'Nihon Tankaku-shu', which accounts for less than 0.4% of the beef distributed in Japan. Iwate Prefecture is said to be the birthplace of the Japanese Short-Horned breed and is the largest production area in the country.

In Kuji City, Iwate Prefecture, the only bullfighting tournament in the Tohoku region is held. Historically, during the Edo period, salt produced in the coastal area was transported to the inland Morioka area using the native 'Nanbu Cattle' (Salt Road). It is said that bullfighting began to determine the leading bull (Wagasa) of the convoy, which led to the start of bullfighting. The event became a tourist attraction in its current form from 1983. (From Kuji City HP)

* Nanbu Cattle underwent crossbreeding with foreign breeds due to the opening of Japan in the Meiji era and was registered as the fourth Japanese beef breed, 'Nihon Tankaku-shu', in 1957.

title: 愛媛県西予市 苔むしろ(2023.2.22)
description: I visited Koke Mushiro, one of the Shikoku 88 scenic spots. The moss garden spread over the stone walls of the terraced rice fields is soothing. The moss is well maintained, creating a space that truly embodies the word 'healing.'

title: 愛媛県宇和島市 南楽園(2023.2.28)
description: I visited Nanaruen in Tsushima Town, Uwajima City, where the plum festival was being held. Nanaruen, with a total area of 153,322 square meters, is the largest Japanese garden in Shikoku, centered around two ponds and showcasing the pinnacle of modern landscaping techniques. It was selected as one of the '100 Best Urban Parks in Japan' in 1989. The meticulously maintained garden is truly a pleasant place.

title: 宇和島市 伊達博物館(2023.3.3)
description: I visited the Date Museum in Uwajima City, where the 'Hina Doll and Hina Furnishings Exhibition' is being held. Since some of the exhibits can be photographed, I would like to introduce them in this video.

title: 宇和島市 天赦園(2023.3.9)
description: I visited Tenshaen in Uwa City. Although it is not the season for wisteria or irises, it is a well-maintained Japanese garden. I would like to visit during the wisteria and iris season as well.

title: 大洲市 肱川緑地 畑の前河川敷広場 菜の花畑(2023.3.13)
description: I went to the Hijikawa Green Space Field Front Riverbed Square Canola Flower Field. The peak has passed, but it is still an impressive flower field. I hope it can be conveyed in a 360° video...

title: 宇和島市 吉田町 国安の郷(2023.3.13)
description: I visited Kuniyasu no Sato in Yoshida Town, Uwa City. It is a facility where you can touch the history of ancient times through buildings and exhibits.

title: 愛媛県歴史文化博物館(2023.3.17)
description: I visited the Ehime Prefectural Museum of History and Culture located in Seiyo City. This museum provides a detailed introduction to the history and folklore of Ehime Prefecture. There are so many exhibits that it may take more than a day to see everything. The layout is designed so that even small children can enjoy it, with buildings recreated from different eras, mini dioramas, and various exhibits.

title: うわじま牛鬼祭り 海上打上花火(2023.7.23)
description: I went to see the fireworks of the Uwajima Ushi Oni Festival. It was about 40 minutes of fireworks from 8:30 to 9:10, but during that time, the main camera had trouble and stopped recording due to overheating, making for a frustrating 40 minutes. However, I managed to stitch together the footage I captured into a video of just under 9 minutes. As for the fireworks, I thought they were generally low in position, but then they shot up to a height that far exceeded the frame, which seemed to be a challenge for those filming. I was using a 360° camera, so I didn't miss the frame, but there were many parts I had to crop in editing. The overall composition was also a bit lacking. Since it was held for the first time in several years, there might be some understandable reasons for that. I look forward to next year.

title: 大洲川まつり 花火大会 夏の陣(2023.8.3)
description: I went to the fireworks festival in Ozu City. It was crowded with many people. Since I'm not good with crowds, I took photos from a distance across the bridge. The fireworks lasted about 45 minutes. The quality of the iPhone 14 is better than that of the Insta360 One X2. However, the fireworks were lower than I expected, so I had to crop the image, which affected the quality...

title: 愛媛県 西予市 田之筋わらパーク(2023.8.4)
description: I went to Tanomusubi Wara Park in Seiyo City. I knew there were other sculptures besides the straw mammoth, but I hadn't been able to find out where they were located, so I couldn't visit them.

title: 宇和島市 みまイルミネーション(2023.12.4)
description: I went to the illumination at Nakayama Pond Nature Park in Mima. This illumination takes advantage of the natural scenery and is held every year at this time. It started yesterday (12/3). There are about 100,000 lights and a 10m tree, making it quite impressive.

title: 宇和島市 みまイルミネーション(2023.12.4)
description:

This illumination takes advantage of the natural scenery and is held every year at this time. It started yesterday (12/3) and features about 100,000 lights and a 10-meter tree, making it quite impressive.

title: 大洲市 少彦名神社(2023.12.19)
description: I visited Ozu City Shōhikona Shrine. Unfortunately, it was raining, but I really wanted to see the worship hall of Shōhikona Shrine, so I went there. The scaffolding for the construction was impressive, and I was captivated by it. Due to the renovation work on the Hijikawa River, it seems that not many people visit, and the main shrine was in a bit of disrepair, which was disappointing.

title: 大洲市冨士山公園展望台からの絶景雲海(2023.12.30)
description: I visited the Tomisuyama Park Observatory in Ozu City. The sea of clouds spread out below me, and I could watch it forever. I was really surprised that such a spectacular view could be seen just 5 minutes from outside Ozu City.

title: 本編：桜満開 大洲城(2024.4.4)
description: On my way back from Matsuyama, I noticed that Ozu Castle was in full bloom with cherry blossoms. Since I had no plans, I decided to make a slight detour. The cherry blossoms were beyond full bloom and were gradually turning into a cherry blossom storm. I think they will still be in good condition for about another week.

title: 愛媛県南予SLのある風景(2024.5.9)
description: I visited four places with SL in the Minami-yo region of Ehime Prefecture.

title: 【本編】高知県香南市 四国自動車博物館(2024.7.12)
description: I visited the Shikoku Automobile Museum, which I had been curious about for a long time. It took about 3 hours to get to Konan City, Kochi Prefecture via Uwajima City, Kihoku, and Tawaramoto. The exhibition had many vehicles that are irresistible for supercar enthusiasts. The limited-time display of the 222D (MR2) was exciting throughout. Personally, I thought the Dino and Crown were the best.

title: 宇和島闘牛 和霊大祭場所 厳選見どころ(2024.7.23)
description: I went to the Uwajima Bullfighting Tournament held for the first time in five years in conjunction with the Wale Festival. It was held in a breezy bullfighting arena under the scorching heat... so hot! The 12th match was scheduled, but due to a bull that fell ill from the heat, it became the 11th match. There were various happenings, including some bulls showing low fighting spirit, but I have carefully edited the highlights from that experience. I hope this video makes you want to attend the next bullfighting event.

title: 宇和島闘牛大会 全12番ダイジェスト(2024.7.23)
description:
The bullfighting tournament was held in conjunction with the Warei Grand Festival, and we have summarized all 12 matches in a digest. Due to requests in the previous video to see all matches, we have uploaded this urgently.

We have included the non-fighting matches and the pre-fight tactics that were omitted in the highlight video.

This weekend is definitely the best time to see them.

title: 伊予市 双海町 犬寄峠の黄色い丘(2025.3.14)
description: I visited the Yellow Hill at Inuyoshi Pass in Twin Seas Town, Iyo City. The weather was mostly cloudy, but true to its name, the yellow hill was almost in full bloom with rapeseed flowers, which was overwhelming. The best viewing time is on the weekend of the 15th and 16th.

title: 愛媛県 大洲市 畑の前河川敷広場(2025.3.14)

title: 西予市野福峠 県道45号(2025.4.1)

Nofuku Pass in Seiyo City can be accessed by entering Prefectural Road 45 from the Seiyo side of Route 56 Hokezu Tunnel and proceeding for a while. The beautiful scenery of the ria coast and the approximately 400 cherry blossom trees in full bloom create a winding drive course, showcasing the stunning harmony of the Uwakai and the mandarin orchards.

title: 宇和島市 遊子水荷浦の段畑(2025.4.30)
description: On the last day of April, I went to the terraced rice fields of Yuko Mizunagura. If you drive about 20 minutes from the city towards the Miura Peninsula, you will see the magnificent terraced fields. I think Uwajima City is quite promoting it, but it seems that it hasn't led to an increase in tourists. On weekends and holidays, the 'Dandan Chaya' at the bottom of the terraced fields is open, where you can enjoy meals such as Uwajima Tai Meshi (sea bream rice) (please check separately for business hours). How about feeling the eternal time in the magnificent terraced fields carved into the mountainside? At 'Dandan Chaya', they have been playing music created by the Meekan Channel as in-store music since before the creation of the CD 'KISAIYA Uwajima', so I support them.

title: 宇和島闘牛５月場所(2025.5.3)
description: One of the four big stages of the year. The Uwajima Bullfighting May Tournament took place on May 3, 2025. The rules of bullfighting are simple: bulls fight each other with no time limit, and the one that runs away loses. The weather was fine, and it was Golden Week, so the event was a huge success, with over 2,400 attendees. It was a long event lasting two and a half hours, but we have summarized the main fights. We hope that we have been able to convey at least a little of the appeal of bullfighting.

title: 天空の城-宇和島城-(AI Music 2025.5.11)
description: Today, the 'Uwajima EXPO' is being held at Kisaiahira, but I dislike crowds, so I went to Uwajima Castle. I climbed up to complete the lyrics of the original song 'Sky Castle - Uwajima Castle.' How to express the compact yet atmospheric image of Uwajima Castle? For now, I went back in time and felt like a samurai... and created it. Initially, the preview on X was sung by a woman, but after coming up here, I thought a male vocal would be better, so I changed it.

title: 天空の城 - 宇和島城 - (2025.8.6)
description: I climbed Uwajima Castle. In this heat, I regretted it while climbing, but I just wanted to see the castle. It was too hot, I lost weight, and I was tired... lol. While climbing, I was thinking about cuts to match a song, but after the museum, I couldn't think about that anymore. It was too hot. Since I was there, I arranged the BGM for 'Sky Castle - Uwajima Castle -' in a Mugen Castle Mix. The first half imagines the tension leading up to the sortie. The song starts a cappella and the orchestra gradually joins in. The summer Uwajima Castle was... a private experience without other tourists. title: 元気になりに、いらっしゃい。【宮崎市】宮崎食堂ムービー｜一人旅編
description:
●Miyazaki Shokudo Homepage
https://www.city.miyazaki.miyazaki.jp/miyazaki-shokudo/

A movie has been created to promote the charm of Miyazaki City through the project "Miyazaki Shokudo." Visitors can experience the rich nature of the sea and mountains under the blue sky, enjoy local foods loved by the community, and connect with people, all of which contribute to their revitalization.

<Solo Travel Edition>
A business person, overwhelmed by work, unexpectedly encounters the "Miyazaki Shokudo" noren (shop curtain) at a café where they were working. As they are naturally drawn in by the noren, they find themselves in a beach burger house doing telework, learning about local food and the "dareyami" culture from the warm people of Nishitachi, and suddenly riding waves in the blue sea after being invited by a surfer they met at a snack bar. After finishing work under the bright sun, they enjoy a relaxing time on the beach... Surrounded by the openness of Miyazaki, they can spend fulfilling time connecting with the warmth of people and the richness of food and nature at Miyazaki Shokudo.

●Music
The song "Tsutsu Uraraka" was written for "Miyazaki Shokudo" by SAKANAMON, a three-piece rock band led by Motoki Fujimori from Miyazaki City. The song, themed around "local pop," is set to a lively rhythm that transitions through various scenes in the movie.

"Tsutsu Uraraka Miyazaki Shokudo Ver."
Lyrics: Motoki Fujimori
Composition: Motoki Fujimori
Artist: SAKANAMON

●What is Miyazaki Shokudo?
Miyazaki City promotes the "Miyazaki Shokudo" project, which envisions the charm of Miyazaki City—its food, nature, and warmth of people—as a "feast" and the entire city as a "place where feasts gather = a dining hall." With the slogan "Come to Get Energized," we will enhance the project with the cooperation of local residents.

●Miyazaki Shokudo Brand Statement
Miyazaki City is a large dining hall.
Casually, without hesitation.
Seasonal and locally exceptional
Delicious food can be enjoyed easily and affordably.
The sea, mountains, sky, and wind
Are all a feast,
Where anyone can relax and regain their energy.
Come to visit anytime.
Always welcome back.

The sightseeing train 'Kitakyushu Bank Retro Line Shiofukugo' runs between Moji Port Retro and Wabukari from spring to autumn, covering the shortest distance in Japan (2.1 km) at the slowest speed (15 km/h).
